title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四: 世祖一
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四: 世祖一 Volume 4 Annals 4: Shizu 1

sentences.zh: 世祖聖德神功文武皇帝，諱忽必烈，睿宗皇帝第四子。

translations.literal: Shizu, the Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil — taboo name Kublai — was the fourth son of Emperor Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu, styled the Emperor Sacred in Virtue, Divine in Achievement, Martial and Civil, bore the personal name Kublai and was the fourth son of Emperor Ruizong Tolui.

sentences.zh: 母莊聖太后，怯烈氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuang Sheng of the Kereit clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuang Sheng of the Kereit, Sorghaghtani Beki.

sentences.zh: 以乙亥歲八月乙卯生。

translations.literal: He was born on the yimao day of the eighth month of the yihai year.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the yimao day of the eighth month of the yihai year.

sentences.zh: 及長，仁明英睿，事太后至孝，尤善撫下。

translations.literal: When he had grown, he was benevolent, clear-sighted, and brilliant; he served the Empress Dowager with the utmost filial devotion and was especially skilled in treating those below him with kindness.
translations.idiomatic: As he matured he proved benevolent, clear-sighted, and brilliant; he served the Empress Dowager with the deepest filial devotion and had a gift for winning the loyalty of those beneath him.

sentences.zh: 納弘吉剌氏為妃。

translations.literal: He took a woman of the Hongjila clan as consort.
translations.idiomatic: He took a woman of the Hongjila clan as his consort.

sentences.zh: 歲甲辰，帝在潛邸，思大有為於天下，延藩府舊臣及四方文學之士，問以治道。

translations.literal: In the jiachen year, while the Emperor was still in his princely residence, he contemplated great undertakings under Heaven, summoned former retainers of the princely household and men of letters from every quarter, and questioned them on the principles of governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiachen year, while Kublai still held his princely establishment, he dreamed of great deeds for the realm. He gathered old retainers of the household and scholars from every direction and asked them how a state ought to be ruled.

sentences.zh: 歲辛亥，六月，憲宗即位，同母弟惟帝最長且賢，故憲宗盡屬以漠南漢地軍國庶事，遂南駐瓜忽都之地。

translations.literal: In the xinhai year, sixth month, when Xianzong acceded to the throne — of the full brothers by the same mother, only the Emperor was eldest and most worthy — Xianzong entrusted to him all military and civil affairs in the Han lands south of the desert, and he therefore encamped south at Guhudu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the xinhai year Möngke took the throne. Of the brothers born to the same mother, Kublai alone was eldest and most capable, and Möngke therefore placed all military and civil affairs of the Han territories south of the steppe in his hands. Kublai moved south and encamped at Guhudu.

sentences.zh: 邢州有兩答剌罕言於帝曰：「邢吾分地也，受封之初，民萬餘戶，今日減月削，才五七百戶耳，宜選良吏撫循之。

translations.literal: At Xingzhou a darughachi reported to the Emperor, saying: "Xing is my allotment. At the time of the grant there were more than ten thousand households; now, month by month they have dwindled until there are only five or six hundred. Worthy officials ought to be chosen to nurture and settle them."
translations.idiomatic: At Xingzhou a darughachi told Kublai, "Xing is my allotted domain. When I first received it there were more than ten thousand households; now they have dwindled month by month until only five or six hundred remain. You should appoint good officials to restore order and care for the people."

sentences.zh: 」帝從其言，承制以脫兀脫及張耕為邢州安撫使，劉肅為商榷使，邢乃大治。

translations.literal: The Emperor heeded him and, exercising imperial authority, appointed Toqtogha and Zhang Geng Pacification Commissioners of Xingzhou and Liu Su Investigation Commissioner; Xing was thereafter greatly governed.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai agreed. Acting with imperial authority, he appointed Toqtogha and Zhang Geng pacification commissioners of Xingzhou and Liu Su investigation commissioner, and Xing was soon well governed.

sentences.zh: 歲壬子，帝駐桓、撫間。

translations.literal: In the renzi year the Emperor encamped between Huan and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the renzi year he encamped between Huan and Fu.

sentences.zh: 憲宗令斷事官牙魯瓦赤與不只兒等總天下財賦於燕，視事一日，殺二十八人。

translations.literal: Xianzong ordered the judicial officer Yalavachi and Bujai'er and others to oversee all the empire's finances at Yan. In one day of office they executed twenty-eight men.
translations.idiomatic: Möngke ordered the judicial officer Yalavachi, Bujai'er, and others to take charge of the empire's revenues at Yan. On their first day in office they put twenty-eight men to death.

sentences.zh: 其一人盜馬者，杖而釋之矣，偶有獻環刀者，遂追還所杖者，手試刀斬之。

translations.literal: One man had stolen a horse; he was beaten with the rod and released. When someone happened to present a ring-handled saber, they recalled the man who had been beaten and personally tested the blade by beheading him.
translations.idiomatic: One man had stolen a horse; they beat him with the rod and let him go. When someone presented a ring-handled saber, they brought the beaten man back and tried the blade on his neck themselves.

sentences.zh: 帝責之曰：「凡死罪，必詳讞而後行刑，今一日殺二十八人，必多非辜。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked them, saying: "In every capital case one must carefully try the matter before carrying out punishment. To kill twenty-eight men in a single day — surely many were innocent."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai rebuked them: "Every capital sentence must be carefully tried before it is carried out. To kill twenty-eight men in one day — surely many were innocent."

sentences.zh: 既杖復斬，此何刑也？

translations.literal: Beaten and then beheaded — what sort of justice is this?
translations.idiomatic: Beaten, then beheaded — what kind of justice is that?"

sentences.zh: 」不只兒錯愕不能對。

translations.literal: Bujai'er was flustered and could not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Bujai'er stood dumbfounded and could not answer.

sentences.zh: 太宗朝立軍儲所於新衛，以收山東、河北丁糧，後惟計直取銀帛，軍行則以資之。

translations.literal: Under Taizong a Military Supply Office was established at Xinwei to collect corvée grain from Shandong and Hebei; later it reckoned only fixed amounts paid in silver and silk, which were drawn on when armies marched.
translations.idiomatic: In Taizong's reign a military supply office was set up at Xinwei to collect corvée grain from Shandong and Hebei; later it took only fixed payments in silver and silk, which were spent when armies took the field.

sentences.zh: 帝請於憲宗，設官築五倉於河上，始令民入粟。

translations.literal: The Emperor petitioned Xianzong to appoint officials and build five granaries on the river, thereby beginning to require the people to contribute grain.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai asked Möngke to appoint officials and build five granaries along the river, and for the first time required the people to deliver grain.

sentences.zh: 宋遣兵攻虢之盧氏、河南之永寧、衛之八柳渡，帝言之憲宗，立經略司於汴，以忙哥、史天澤、楊惟中、趙璧為使，陳紀、楊果為參議，俾屯田唐、鄧等州，授之兵、牛，敵至則禦，敵去則耕，仍置屯田萬戶於鄧，完城以備之。

translations.literal: The Song sent troops to attack Lushi in Guo, Yongning in Henan, and Bayangdu in Wei. The Emperor reported this to Xianzong, and a Frontier Affairs Commission was established at Bian with Möngke, Shi Tianze, Yang Weizhong, and Zhao Bi as commissioners and Chen Ji and Yang Guo as counsellors, ordering them to garrison and farm in Tang, Deng, and other prefectures, supplying them with troops and oxen — when the enemy came they would defend, when the enemy left they would plow — and a garrison-farming office of ten thousand households was also placed at Deng to complete the fortifications.
translations.idiomatic: The Song attacked Lushi in Guo, Yongning in Henan, and Bayangdu in Wei. Kublai reported this to Möngke, who established a frontier affairs commission at Bian with Möngke, Shi Tianze, Yang Weizhong, and Zhao Bi as commissioners and Chen Ji and Yang Guo as counsellors. They were to farm and garrison Tang, Deng, and neighboring prefectures, given troops and oxen to fight when the enemy came and plow when they withdrew. A garrison-farming office of ten thousand households was also set at Deng to finish the walls.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，入覲憲宗於曲先惱兒之地，奉命帥師征雲南。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer he had audience with Xianzong at Quxiannao'er and received orders to lead an army against Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer he had audience with Möngke at Quxiannao'er and received orders to lead an expedition against Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，祃牙西行。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingwu day, the war standard was consecrated and the march west began.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the bingwu day, the army consecrated its standards and marched west.

sentences.zh: 歲癸丑，受京兆分地。

translations.literal: In the guichou year he received the allotment of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the guichou year he received Jingzhao as his allotted domain.

sentences.zh: 諸將皆築第京兆，豪侈相尚，帝即分遣，使戍興元諸州。

translations.literal: The generals all built mansions at Jingzhao and vied in extravagance. The Emperor at once dispersed them, sending them to garrison Xingyuan and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The generals all built lavish mansions at Jingzhao and competed in extravagance. Kublai immediately dispersed them, sending them to garrison Xingyuan and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又奏割河東解州鹽池以供軍食，立從宜府於京兆，屯田鳳翔，募民受鹽入粟，轉漕嘉陵。

translations.literal: He also memorialized to carve out the salt ponds of Jiezhou in Hedong to supply the army, established a provisional office at Jingzhao, garrison-farmed at Fengxiang, recruited people to receive salt in exchange for grain, and transported it by water to Jialing.
translations.idiomatic: He also petitioned to set aside the salt ponds of Jiezhou in Hedong for military supply, established a provisional office at Jingzhao, opened garrison farms at Fengxiang, recruited people to trade grain for salt, and shipped the grain by water to Jialing.

sentences.zh: 夏，遣王府尚書姚樞立京兆宣撫司，以孛蘭及楊惟中為使，關隴大治。

translations.literal: In summer the Prince's Household Minister Yao Shu established the Jingzhao Pacification Office, with Bolan and Yang Weizhong as commissioners; Guan and Long were greatly governed.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the prince's household minister Yao Shu established the Jingzhao pacification office with Bolan and Yang Weizhong as commissioners, and the Guan and Long region was brought to good order.

sentences.zh: 又立交鈔提舉司，印鈔以佐經用。

translations.literal: He also established an Office for the Issue of Paper Currency and printed notes to supplement expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: He also established an office for issuing paper currency and printed notes to help meet expenses.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，師次臨洮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn the army halted at Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn the army halted at Lintao.

sentences.zh: 遣玉律術、王君候、王鑒諭大理，不果行。

translations.literal: Yulüshi, Wang Junhou, and Wang Jian were sent to announce the purpose of the campaign to Dali, but the mission did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Yulüshi, Wang Junhou, and Wang Jian to announce his intentions to Dali, but the mission came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，師次忒剌，分三道以進。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the ninth month the army halted at Tela and advanced in three columns.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the ninth month the army halted at Tela and divided into three columns to advance.

sentences.zh: 大將兀良合帶率西道兵，由晏當路；

translations.literal: The great general Uriyangqadai led the western column by the Yandang route.
translations.idiomatic: The great general Uriyangqadai led the western column by the Yandang route.

sentences.zh: 諸王抄合、也只烈帥東道兵，由白蠻；

translations.literal: The princes Chagha and Je'üle led the eastern column by way of the Bai tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The princes Chagha and Je'üle led the eastern column through Bai territory.

sentences.zh: 帝由中道。

translations.literal: The Emperor took the central route.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai himself took the center column.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至滿陀城，留輜重。

translations.literal: On the yisi day they reached Manto City and left the baggage train behind.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day they reached Manto City and left the baggage train behind.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，過大渡河，又經行山谷二千餘里，至金沙江，乘革囊及筏以渡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingwu day, they crossed the Dadu River, then traveled more than two thousand li through mountain valleys to the Jinsha River, crossing on leather rafts and floats.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the bingwu day, they crossed the Dadu River, then marched more than two thousand li through mountain valleys to the Jinsha River and crossed on leather rafts and floats.

sentences.zh: 摩娑蠻主迎降，其地在大理北四百餘里。

translations.literal: The chief of the Mosuo tribes came out to surrender; their land lay more than four hundred li north of Dali.
translations.idiomatic: The chief of the Mosuo tribes came out to surrender; their territory lay more than four hundred li north of Dali.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，復遣玉律術等使大理。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day of the eleventh month Yulüshi and others were again sent as envoys to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day of the eleventh month Yulüshi and the others were again dispatched as envoys to Dali.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，師至白蠻打郭寨，其主將出降，其侄堅壁拒守，攻拔殺之，不及其民。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day the army reached the Bai fortress of Daguo; its commander came out to surrender, but his nephew held the walls and resisted. The fortress was taken by assault and he was killed, without harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day the army reached the Bai fortress of Daguo. Its commander came out to surrender, but his nephew barricaded the walls and resisted. The fortress was stormed and the nephew was killed, without harm to the people.

sentences.zh: 庚子，次三甸。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day they halted at Sandian.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day they halted at Sandian.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，白蠻送款。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day the Bai tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the Bai tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，軍薄大理城。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month the army drew near Dali City.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the twelfth month the army drew up before Dali City.

sentences.zh: 初，大理主段氏微弱，國事皆決於高祥、高和兄弟，是夜，祥率眾遁去，命大將也古及拔突兒追之。

translations.literal: Earlier the ruler of Dali, of the Duan clan, had been weak, and state affairs were all decided by the brothers Gao Xiang and Gao He. That night Xiang fled with his followers, and the great generals Yeke and Batu'er were ordered to pursue him.
translations.idiomatic: Dali's ruler, of the Duan clan, had long been weak; state affairs were decided by the brothers Gao Xiang and Gao He. That night Xiang fled with his followers, and the generals Yeke and Batu'er were sent in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 帝既入大理，曰：「城破而我使不出，計必死矣。

translations.literal: After the Emperor entered Dali he said: "The city has fallen and our envoys have not returned — they must surely be dead."
translations.idiomatic: After Kublai entered Dali he said, "The city is taken and our envoys have not come out — they must be dead."

sentences.zh: 」己未，西道兵亦至，命姚樞等搜訪圖籍，乃得三使屍。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day the western column also arrived. Yao Shu and others were ordered to search out the archives, and the bodies of the three envoys were found.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day the western column also arrived. Yao Shu and others were ordered to search the archives, and the bodies of the three envoys were found.

sentences.zh: 既瘞，命樞為文祭之。

translations.literal: After they were buried, Shu was ordered to compose a funeral elegy.
translations.idiomatic: After they were buried, Shu was ordered to compose a funeral elegy for them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，南出龍首城，次趙瞼。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day they marched south out of Longshou City and halted at Zhaojian.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day they marched south out of Longshou City and halted at Zhaojian.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，獲高祥，斬於姚州。

translations.literal: On the guihai day Gao Xiang was captured and beheaded at Yaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day Gao Xiang was captured and beheaded at Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 留大將兀良合帶戍守，以劉時中為宣撫使，與段氏同安輯大理，遂班師。

translations.literal: The great general Uriyangqadai was left to garrison the region; Liu Shizhong was made Pacification Commissioner to settle Dali together with the Duan clan, and the army then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Uriyangqadai was left to garrison the region; Liu Shizhong was appointed pacification commissioner to settle Dali together with the Duan clan, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 歲甲寅，夏五月庚子，駐六盤山。

translations.literal: In the jiayin year, on the gengzi day of the fifth month of summer, he encamped at Liupanshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiayin year, on the gengzi day of the fifth month of summer, he encamped at Liupanshan.

sentences.zh: 六月，以廉希憲為關西道宣撫使，姚樞為勸農使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Lian Xixian was made Pacification Commissioner of the Guanxi Circuit and Yao Shu Agriculture Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Lian Xixian was appointed pacification commissioner of the Guanxi circuit and Yao Shu agriculture commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，至自大理，駐桓、撫間，復立撫州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn he returned from Dali and encamped between Huan and Fu; Fu Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he returned from Dali and encamped between Huan and Fu; Fu Prefecture was re-established.

sentences.zh: 冬，駐瓜忽都之地。

translations.literal: In winter he encamped at Guhudu.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he encamped at Guhudu.

sentences.zh: 歲乙卯，春，復駐桓、撫間。

translations.literal: In the yimao year, spring, he again encamped between Huan and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the yimao year he again encamped between Huan and Fu.

sentences.zh: 冬，駐奉聖州北。

translations.literal: In winter he encamped north of Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he encamped north of Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歲丙辰，春三月，命僧子聰卜地於桓州東、灤水北，城開平府，經營宮室。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the bingchen year the monk Zicong was ordered to choose a site east of Huan Prefecture and north of the Luan River to build Kaiping Prefecture and lay out the palace halls.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the bingchen year the monk Zicong was ordered to choose a site east of Huan Prefecture and north of the Luan River to build Kaiping Prefecture and lay out the palace halls.

sentences.zh: 冬，駐於合剌八剌合孫之地。

translations.literal: In winter he encamped at Helababakhasun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he encamped at Helababakhasun.

sentences.zh: 憲宗命益懷州為分地。

translations.literal: Xianzong assigned Huai Prefecture as an additional allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Möngke assigned Huai Prefecture as an additional allotment.

sentences.zh: 歲丁巳，春，憲宗命阿藍答兒、劉太平會計京兆、河南財賦，大加鉤考，其貧不能輸者，帝為代償之。

translations.literal: In the dingsi year, spring, Xianzong ordered Alandar and Liu Taiping to audit the finances of Jingzhao and Henan; they conducted a severe investigation, and for those too poor to pay, the Emperor paid on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the dingsi year Möngke ordered Alandar and Liu Taiping to audit the finances of Jingzhao and Henan. Their investigation was harsh, and for those too poor to pay Kublai covered the debts himself.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，入覲於也可叠烈孫之地，議分道攻宋，以明年為期。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter he had audience at Yekedieliesun and discussed dividing forces to attack the Song, setting the following year as the date.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter he had audience at Yekedieliesun. They discussed dividing forces to attack the Song, with the following year as the target date.

sentences.zh: 歲戊午，冬十一月戊申，祃牙於開平東北，是日啟行。

translations.literal: In the wuwu year, on the wushen day of the eleventh month of winter, the war standard was consecrated northeast of Kaiping; that same day the march began.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year, on the wushen day of the eleventh month of winter, the army consecrated its standards northeast of Kaiping and set out that same day.

sentences.zh: 歲己未，春二月，會諸王於邢州。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the jiwei year the princes assembled at Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the jiwei year the princes assembled at Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，駐小濮州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer he encamped at Xiao Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer he encamped at Xiao Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 征東平宋子貞、李昶，訪問得失。

translations.literal: Song Zizhen and Li Chang of Dongping were summoned and questioned on what had succeeded and what had failed.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zizhen and Li Chang of Dongping were summoned and asked what had succeeded and what had failed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲寅，次汝南，命大將拔都兒等前行，備糧漢上，戒諸將毋妄殺。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the seventh month of autumn he halted at Runan and ordered the great general Batu'er and others to go ahead and prepare provisions on the Han River, warning the generals not to kill without cause.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the seventh month of autumn he halted at Runan and ordered the great general Batu'er and others to go ahead and prepare provisions along the Han River, warning the generals not to kill without cause.

sentences.zh: 命楊惟中、郝經宣撫江淮，必阇赤孫貞督軍須蔡州。

translations.literal: Yang Weizhong and Hao Jing were ordered to pacify the Jiang-Huai region, and Biyeke Sunzhen was to command troops at Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Weizhong and Hao Jing were ordered to pacify the Jiang-Huai region, and Biyeke Sunzhen was to command troops at Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 有軍士犯法者，貞縛致有司，白於帝，命戮以徇，諸軍凜然，無敢犯令者。

translations.literal: When soldiers violated the law, Sunzhen bound them and delivered them to the authorities, reporting to the Emperor, who ordered them executed as a warning; the armies were awed and none dared break the orders.
translations.idiomatic: When soldiers broke the law, Sunzhen bound them and handed them over to the civil authorities, reporting to Kublai, who ordered them executed as a warning. The armies were awed and none dared violate orders again.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，渡淮。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the eighth month they crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the eighth month they crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，入大勝關，宋戍兵皆遁。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day they entered Dasheng Pass; the Song garrison troops all fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day they entered Dasheng Pass; the Song garrison troops all fled.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次黃陂。

translations.literal: On the renchen day they halted at Huangpi.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day they halted at Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣廉希憲招臺山寨，比至，千戶董文炳等已破之。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day Lian Xixian was sent to summon Taishan Fortress to surrender; by the time he arrived, the chiliarch Dong Wenbing and others had already taken it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Lian Xixian was sent to summon Taishan Fortress to surrender; by the time he arrived, the chiliarch Dong Wenbing and others had already taken it.

sentences.zh: 時淮民被俘者眾，悉縱之。

translations.literal: At that time many people of the Huai region had been taken captive; all were released.
translations.idiomatic: Many people of the Huai region had been taken captive; Kublai released them all.

sentences.zh: 庚子，先鋒茶忽得宋沿江制置司榜來上，有云：「今夏諜者聞北兵會議，取黃陂民船系筏，由陽邏堡以渡，會於鄂州。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day the vanguard Chagudai presented a proclamation from the Song Riverine Pacification Office, which read: "This summer our spies heard the northern army discuss taking the boats of the people of Huangpi, tying them into rafts, crossing by Yangluo Fort, and assembling at Ezhou."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the vanguard Chagudai presented a proclamation from the Song riverine pacification office. It read: "This summer our spies heard the northern army plan to seize the boats of Huangpi's people, lash them into rafts, cross at Yangluo Fort, and assemble at Ezhou."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此事前所未有，願如其言。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This has never happened before — I would gladly have it come to pass as they say."
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "Nothing like this has ever been done — I would gladly see it happen just as they say."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，師次江北。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day the army halted north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day the army halted on the north bank of the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅朔，親王穆哥自合州釣魚山遣使以憲宗凶問來告，且請北歸以系天下之望。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, Prince Möngke sent envoys from Diaoyu Mountain at Hezhou to report Xianzong's death and to ask that the Emperor return north to secure the hopes of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month Prince Möngke sent envoys from Diaoyu Mountain at Hezhou with news of Möngke's death, asking Kublai to return north at once to secure the hopes of the realm.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「吾奉命南來，豈可無功遽還？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I was ordered south — how can I return without achievement?"
translations.idiomatic: Kublai said, "I was ordered south — how can I turn back without accomplishing anything?"

sentences.zh: 「甲辰，登香爐山，俯瞰大江，江北曰武湖，湖之東曰陽邏堡，其南岸即滸黃洲。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day he ascended Xianglu Mountain and looked down on the great river. North of the river was Wuhu Lake; east of the lake was Yangluo Fort, and on the south bank opposite it was Huhuang Isle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day he climbed Xianglu Mountain and looked down on the great river. North of the river lay Wuhu Lake; east of the lake stood Yangluo Fort, and on the south bank opposite it was Huhuang Isle.

sentences.zh: 宋以大舟扼江渡，帝遣兵奪二大舟，是夜，遣木魯花赤、張文謙等具舟楫。

translations.literal: The Song blocked the crossing with large ships. The Emperor sent troops to seize two large vessels, and that night Murghulji, Zhang Wenqian, and others prepared boats and rafts.
translations.idiomatic: The Song blocked the crossing with large ships. Kublai sent troops to seize two of them, and that night Murghulji, Zhang Wenqian, and others prepared boats and rafts.

sentences.zh: 乙巳遲明，至江岸，風雨晦冥，諸將皆以為未可渡，帝不從，遂申敕將帥揚旗伐鼓，三道並進，天為開霽。

translations.literal: On the yisi day, as dawn came late, they reached the riverbank. Wind and rain made the sky dark; the generals all said it was not yet possible to cross, but the Emperor would not listen. He then ordered the commanders to raise banners and beat drums; the three columns advanced together, and Heaven cleared the weather.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day, near dawn, they reached the riverbank. Wind and rain shrouded the sky; the generals all said the crossing was impossible, but Kublai would not listen. He ordered the commanders to raise banners and beat drums; the three columns advanced together, and the sky cleared.

sentences.zh: 與宋師接戰者三，殺獲甚眾，徑達南岸。

translations.literal: They joined battle with the Song army three times, killing and capturing many, and reached the south bank directly.
translations.idiomatic: They fought the Song army three times, killing and capturing many, and reached the south bank in a straight push.

sentences.zh: 軍士有擅入民家者，以軍法從事。

translations.literal: Soldiers who entered private houses without leave were punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers who entered private houses without leave were punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 凡所俘獲，悉縱之。

translations.literal: All captives were released.
translations.idiomatic: All captives were released.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣王沖道、李宗傑、訾郊招諭鄂城，比至東門，矢下如雨，沖道墜馬，為敵所獲，宗傑、郊奔還。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day Wang Chongdao, Li Zongjie, and Zijiao were sent to summon Ezhou to surrender. When they reached the east gate, arrows fell like rain; Chongdao fell from his horse and was captured by the enemy, while Zongjie and Zijiao fled back.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Wang Chongdao, Li Zongjie, and Zijiao were sent to summon Ezhou to surrender. At the east gate arrows fell like rain; Chongdao fell from his horse and was taken by the enemy, while Zongjie and Zijiao fled back.

sentences.zh: 帝駐滸黃洲。

translations.literal: The Emperor encamped at Huhuang Isle.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai encamped at Huhuang Isle.

sentences.zh: 己酉，抵鄂，屯兵教場。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day he reached Ezhou and encamped at the drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day he reached Ezhou and encamped at the drill ground.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，圍鄂。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day he besieged Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day he besieged Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，登城東北壓雲亭，立望樓，高可五丈，望見城中出兵，趣兵迎擊，生擒二人，云：「賈似道率兵救鄂，事起倉卒，皆非精銳。

translations.literal: On the renzi day he ascended the Yanyun Pavilion in the northeast of the wall and erected a watchtower more than five zhang high. When he saw troops sally from the city he hurried forces to meet them and captured two men alive, who said: "Jia Sidao is leading troops to relieve Ezhou. The affair was raised in haste; none are elite troops."
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day he climbed the Yanyun Pavilion in the northeast corner of the wall and built a watchtower nearly five zhang high. When he saw troops sally from the city he sent forces to meet them and took two men alive. They said, "Jia Sidao is leading troops to relieve Ezhou, but the call was sudden — none are elite soldiers."

sentences.zh: 」遂命官取逃民棄糧，聚之軍中，為攻取計。

translations.literal: He then ordered officials to collect abandoned grain from fugitive people and gather it in the army for use in the assault.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered officials to collect grain abandoned by fugitives and stock it in the camp for the assault.

sentences.zh: 戊午，順天萬戶張柔兵至。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day Zhang Rou, commander of ten thousand households of Shuntian, arrived with his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Zhang Rou, commander of ten thousand households of Shuntian, arrived with his troops.

sentences.zh: 大將拔突兒等以舟師趨岳州，遇宋將呂文德自重慶來，拔都兒等迎戰，文德乘夜入鄂城，守愈堅。

translations.literal: The great general Batu'er and others led the fleet toward Yuezhou. They met the Song general Lü Wende coming from Chongqing; Batu'er and others gave battle. Wende entered Ezhou by night, and the defense grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: The great general Batu'er and others led the fleet toward Yuezhou and met the Song general Lü Wende coming from Chongqing. Batu'er and the others gave battle. Wende slipped into Ezhou by night, and the defense grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，移駐烏龜山。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter he moved camp to Wugui Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month of winter he moved camp to Wugui Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，拔突兒還自嶽。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day Batu'er returned from Yue.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Batu'er returned from Yue.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，移駐牛頭山。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month he moved camp to Niutou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month he moved camp to Niutou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 兀良合帶略地諸蠻，由交趾歷邕、桂，抵潭州，聞帝在鄂，遣使來告。

translations.literal: Uriyangqadai raided through the various tribal lands, passing by way of Jiaozhi through Yong and Gui to Tanzhou. Hearing that the Emperor was at Ezhou, he sent envoys to report.
translations.idiomatic: Uriyangqadai raided through the tribal lands, passing by Jiaozhi through Yong and Gui to Tanzhou. Hearing that Kublai was at Ezhou, he sent envoys to report.

sentences.zh: 時先朝諸臣阿藍答兒、渾都海、脫火思、脫裏赤等謀立阿裏不哥。

translations.literal: At that time former ministers of the previous reign — Alandar, Qunduqai, Toqosi, and Toqichi — plotted to install Ariq Böke.
translations.idiomatic: At that time former ministers of the previous reign — Alandar, Qunduqai, Toqosi, and Toqichi — plotted to install Ariq Böke.

sentences.zh: 阿裏不哥者，睿宗第七子，帝之弟也。

translations.literal: Ariq Böke was the seventh son of Ruizong and the Emperor's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Ariq Böke was the seventh son of Ruizong Tolui and Kublai's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 於是阿藍答兒發兵於漠北諸部，脫裏赤括兵於漠南諸州，而阿藍答兒乘傳調兵，去開平僅百餘里。

translations.literal: Thereupon Alandar raised troops among the tribes of the northern desert, Toqichi gathered soldiers in the southern desert prefectures, and Alandar, traveling by post relay, mobilized troops only a little more than a hundred li from Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: Alandar raised troops among the northern tribes, Toqichi gathered soldiers in the southern prefectures, and Alandar, traveling by post relay, mobilized troops only a little more than a hundred li from Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 皇后聞之，使人謂之曰：「發兵大事，太祖皇帝曾孫真金在此，何故不令知之？

translations.literal: When the Empress heard of it she sent someone to say: "Raising troops is a grave matter. Zhenjin, great-grandson of Taizu, is here — why was he not told?"
translations.idiomatic: When the empress heard of it she sent word: "Raising troops is a grave matter. Zhenjin, Taizu's great-grandson, is here — why was he not told?"

sentences.zh: 」阿藍答兒不能答。

translations.literal: Alandar could not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Alandar could not answer.

sentences.zh: 繼又聞脫裏赤亦至燕，後即遣脫歡、愛莫幹馳至軍前密報，請速還。

translations.literal: Soon word also came that Toqichi had reached Yan. The Empress then dispatched Toghan and Eimogen at full speed to the army with a secret report, asking for a swift return.
translations.idiomatic: Word soon came that Toqichi had reached Yan as well. The empress then dispatched Toghan and Eimogen at full speed to the army with a secret report, urging a swift return.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，發牛頭山，聲言趣臨安，留大將拔突兒等帥諸軍圍鄂。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day he set out from Niutou Mountain, declaring that he was hurrying toward Lin'an, and left the great general Batu'er and others to command the armies besieging Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day he set out from Niutou Mountain, declaring that he was hurrying toward Lin'an, and left the great general Batu'er and others to command the armies besieging Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午朔，還駐青山磯。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary month he returned and encamped at Qingshanji.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the intercalary month he returned and encamped at Qingshanji.

sentences.zh: 辛未，臨江岸，遣張文謙還諭諸將曰：「遲六日，當去鄂退保滸黃洲。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day he came to the riverbank and sent Zhang Wenqian back to tell the generals: "In six days we shall leave Ezhou and withdraw to hold Huhuang Isle."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day he came to the riverbank and sent Zhang Wenqian back to tell the generals, "In six days we shall leave Ezhou and fall back to Huhuang Isle."

sentences.zh: 」命文謙發降民二萬北歸。

translations.literal: Wenqian was ordered to send twenty thousand surrendered people north.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqian was ordered to send twenty thousand surrendered people north.

sentences.zh: 宋賈似道遣宋京請和，命趙璧等語之曰：「汝以生靈之故來請和好，其意甚善，然我奉命南征，豈能中止？

translations.literal: Jia Sidao of the Song sent Song Jing to sue for peace. Zhao Bi and others were ordered to tell him: "You come seeking peace for the sake of the people — that intention is good. Yet I was ordered south on campaign — how can I halt midway?"
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao of the Song sent Song Jing to sue for peace. Zhao Bi and others were told to reply, "You come seeking peace for the people's sake — that is a good intention. Yet I was ordered south on campaign — how can I stop midway?"

sentences.zh: 果有事大之心，當請於朝。

translations.literal: If you truly wish to serve a greater cause, you should petition your court.
translations.idiomatic: If you truly wish to serve a greater cause, petition your court."

sentences.zh: 」是日，大軍北還。

translations.literal: That same day the great army withdrew north.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the great army withdrew north.

sentences.zh: 己丑，至燕。

translations.literal: On the jichou day he reached Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day he reached Yan.

sentences.zh: 脫裏赤方括民兵，民甚苦之，帝詰其由，托以憲宗臨終之命。

translations.literal: Toqichi was then conscripting militia; the people suffered greatly. The Emperor questioned the reason, and he pleaded Xianzong's dying command.
translations.idiomatic: Toqichi was then conscripting militia, and the people suffered greatly. Kublai questioned the reason, and Toqichi pleaded Möngke's dying command.

sentences.zh: 帝察其包藏禍心，所集兵皆縱之，人心大悅。

translations.literal: The Emperor saw that he harbored evil intent; all the troops he had gathered were disbanded, and hearts were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai saw that he harbored treacherous intent and disbanded all the troops he had gathered; the people were greatly relieved.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐燕京近郊。

translations.literal: That winter he encamped near the suburbs of Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he encamped in the suburbs of Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 中統元年春三月戊辰朔，車駕至開平。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the first year of Zhongtong, on the first day, wuchen, the imperial carriage reached Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the first year of Zhongtong, on the wuchen new moon, the imperial carriage reached Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 親王合丹、阿只吉率西道諸王，塔察兒、也先哥、忽剌忽兒、爪都率東道諸王，皆來會，與諸大臣勸進。

translations.literal: Prince Hetan and Ajigi led the princes of the western route; Tachar, Yesünke, Qulqul, and Jadu led the princes of the eastern route — all came to the assembly and, with the great ministers, urged the Emperor to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Hetan and Ajigi led the western princes; Tachar, Yesünke, Qulqul, and Jadu led the eastern princes — all came to the assembly and, with the great ministers, urged Kublai to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝三讓，諸王大臣固請。

translations.literal: The Emperor declined three times; the princes and ministers firmly pressed him.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai declined three times; the princes and ministers pressed him all the more firmly.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝即皇帝位，以祃祃、趙璧、董文炳為燕京路宣慰使。

translations.literal: On the xinmao day the Emperor took the imperial throne and appointed Mamma, Zhao Bi, and Dong Wenbing Pacification Commissioners of the Yanjing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Kublai took the imperial throne and appointed Mamma, Zhao Bi, and Dong Wenbing pacification commissioners of the Yanjing circuit.

sentences.zh: 陜西宣撫使廉希憲言：「高麗國王嘗遣其世子倎入覲，會憲宗將兵攻宋，倎留三年不遣。

translations.literal: Lian Xixian, Pacification Commissioner of Shaanxi, said: "The King of Goryeo once sent his heir Tan to audience. When Xianzong took the field against the Song, Tan was detained for three years and not sent home."
translations.idiomatic: Lian Xixian, pacification commissioner of Shaanxi, said, "The king of Goryeo once sent his heir Tan to court. When Möngke marched against the Song, Tan was kept three years and not sent home."

sentences.zh: 今聞其父已死，若立倎，遣歸國，彼必懷德於我，是不煩兵而得一國也。

translations.literal: Now we hear his father has died. If Tan is enthroned and sent home, he will surely owe us gratitude — thus we gain a kingdom without troubling the army.
translations.idiomatic: Now we hear his father is dead. If we enthrone Tan and send him home, he will owe us gratitude — and we gain a kingdom without troubling the army."

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言，改館倎，以兵衛送之，仍赦其境內。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and changed Tan's lodging, sent him home under military escort, and still granted amnesty within his borders.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai agreed. He changed Tan's lodging, sent him home under military escort, and granted amnesty within Goryeo's borders.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌朔，立中書省，以王文統為平章政事，張文謙為左丞。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, wuxu, the Secretariat was established, with Wang Wentong as Grand Councillor and Zhang Wenqian as Left Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the fourth month of summer the Secretariat was established, with Wang Wentong as grand councillor and Zhang Wenqian as left councillor.

sentences.zh: 以八春、廉希憲、商挺為陜西四川等路宣撫使，趙良弼參議司事，粘合南合、張啟元為西京等處宣撫使。

translations.literal: Bachun, Lian Xixian, and Shang Ting were made Pacification Commissioners of Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other circuits; Zhao Liangbi was Counsellor of the Commission; Nayanan and Zhang Qiyuan were Pacification Commissioners of Xijing and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Bachun, Lian Xixian, and Shang Ting were made pacification commissioners of Shaanxi, Sichuan, and other circuits; Zhao Liangbi was counsellor of the commission; Nayanan and Zhang Qiyuan were pacification commissioners of Xijing and other places.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔諭高麗國王王倎，仍歸所俘民及其逃戶，禁邊將勿擅掠。

translations.literal: On the jihai day an edict announced King Tan of Goryeo, still returning captured people and fugitive households and forbidding frontier generals to plunder on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict went to King Tan of Goryeo, ordering the return of captured people and fugitive households and forbidding frontier generals to plunder on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以即位詔天下。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day he proclaimed his accession to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day he proclaimed his accession to the realm.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: The edict read:
translations.idiomatic: The edict read:

sentences.zh: 朕惟祖宗肇造區宇，奄有四方，武功叠興，文治多缺，五十餘年於此矣。

translations.literal: We consider that our ancestors founded the realm and took possession of the four quarters; martial achievement rose again and again, yet civil governance remained largely lacking — more than fifty years have passed in this condition.
translations.idiomatic: We consider that our ancestors founded the realm and took possession of the four quarters; martial achievement rose again and again, yet civil governance remained largely lacking — more than fifty years have passed in this condition.

sentences.zh: 蓋時有先後，事有緩急，天下大業，非一聖一朝所能兼備也。

translations.literal: Times have their order, affairs their urgency; the great enterprise under Heaven cannot be fully accomplished by one sage in one reign.
translations.idiomatic: Times have their order and affairs their urgency; the great enterprise under Heaven cannot be fully accomplished by one sage in one reign.

sentences.zh: 先皇帝即位之初，風飛雷厲，將大有為。

translations.literal: When the late Emperor first ascended the throne, his momentum was like wind and thunder; he intended great deeds.
translations.idiomatic: When the late Emperor first ascended the throne, his momentum was like wind and thunder; he intended great deeds.

sentences.zh: 憂國愛民之心雖切於己，尊賢使能之道未得其人。

translations.literal: Though his heart to cherish the state and love the people burned in himself, the way to honor the worthy and employ the capable had not yet found its men.
translations.idiomatic: Though his heart to cherish the state and love the people burned within him, he had not yet found the men to honor the worthy and employ the capable.

sentences.zh: 方董夔門之師，遽遺鼎湖之泣。

translations.literal: Just as he was directing the army at Kuimen, he suddenly left the lament of Dinghu.
translations.idiomatic: Just as he was directing the army at Kuimen, he suddenly left the lament of Dinghu.

sentences.zh: 豈期遺恨，竟勿克終。

translations.literal: Who could have expected that regret would in the end go unfulfilled?
translations.idiomatic: Who could have expected that regret would in the end go unfulfilled?

sentences.zh: 肆予沖人，渡江之後，蓋將深入焉，乃聞國中重以僉軍之擾，黎民驚駭，若不能一朝居者。

translations.literal: We, a man of little stature, after crossing the river intended to press deeper; then we heard that at home repeated conscription was disturbing the realm, and the people were terrified as if they could not live from one morning to the next.
translations.idiomatic: We, a man of little stature, after crossing the river intended to press deeper; then we heard that at home repeated conscription was disturbing the realm, and the people were terrified as if they could not live from one morning to the next.

sentences.zh: 予為此懼，驲騎馳歸。

translations.literal: We were afraid because of this and rode post-horses home in haste.
translations.idiomatic: We were afraid because of this and rode post-horses home in haste.

sentences.zh: 目前之急雖紓，境外之兵未戢。

translations.literal: Though the immediate crisis was eased, troops beyond the borders had not yet been stilled.
translations.idiomatic: Though the immediate crisis was eased, troops beyond the borders had not yet been stilled.

sentences.zh: 乃會群議，以集良規。

translations.literal: We then convened collective counsel to gather good plans.
translations.idiomatic: We then convened collective counsel to gather good plans.

sentences.zh: 不意宗盟，輒先推戴。

translations.literal: We did not expect the bond of the clans to press forward first in raising us up.
translations.idiomatic: We did not expect the bond of the clans to press forward first in raising us up.

sentences.zh: 左右萬里，名王巨臣，不召而來者有之，不謀而同者皆是，咸謂國家之大統不可久曠，神人之重寄不可暫虛。

translations.literal: From east and west for ten thousand li, famed princes and great ministers — some came without being summoned, some agreed without being consulted — all said that the great succession of the state could not long stand vacant, nor the heavy charge of gods and men remain briefly unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: From east and west for ten thousand li, famed princes and great ministers — some came without being summoned, some agreed without being consulted — all said that the great succession of the state could not long stand vacant, nor the heavy charge of gods and men remain briefly unfilled.

sentences.zh: 求之今日，太祖嫡孫之中，先皇母弟之列，以賢以長，止予一人。

translations.literal: Sought for today among the direct grandsons of Taizu and among the younger brothers of the late Emperor by the same mother, in worth and in seniority there is only us alone.
translations.idiomatic: Sought for today among Taizu's direct grandsons and among the late Emperor's younger brothers by the same mother, in worth and in seniority there is only us alone.

sentences.zh: 雖在征伐之間，每存仁愛之念，博施濟眾，實可為天下主。

translations.literal: Though amid campaigns we have always kept thoughts of benevolence; broadly bestowing and relieving the multitude, we may truly serve as sovereign of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Though amid campaigns we have always kept thoughts of benevolence; broadly bestowing and relieving the multitude, we may truly serve as sovereign of the realm.

sentences.zh: 天道助順，人謨與能。

translations.literal: Heaven's Way assists the obedient; human counsel joins with capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's Way assists the obedient; human counsel joins with capacity.

sentences.zh: 祖訓傳國大典，於是乎在，孰敢不從。

translations.literal: The ancestral instruction and the great rite of transmitting the realm lie herein — who would dare not follow?
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral instruction and the great rite of transmitting the realm lie herein — who would dare not follow?

sentences.zh: 朕峻辭固讓，至於再三，祈懇益堅，誓以死請。

translations.literal: We sternly refused and firmly declined, even to a third time; the earnest pleas grew firmer, and we swore to refuse unto death.
translations.idiomatic: We sternly refused and firmly declined, even to a third time; the earnest pleas grew firmer, and we swore to refuse unto death.

sentences.zh: 於是俯徇輿情，勉登大寶。

translations.literal: Thereupon, bowing to the sentiment of the people, we reluctantly ascended the great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, bowing to the sentiment of the people, we reluctantly ascended the great treasure.

sentences.zh: 自惟寡昧，屬時多艱，若涉淵冰，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: We ourselves consider our ignorance; the times are many in hardship — as if treading deep ice, we know not how to cross.
translations.idiomatic: We ourselves consider our ignorance; the times are many in hardship — as if treading deep ice, we know not how to cross.

sentences.zh: 爰當臨御之始，宜新弘遠之規。

translations.literal: Now at the beginning of rule, broad and far-reaching plans ought to be made new.
translations.idiomatic: Now at the beginning of rule, broad and far-reaching plans ought to be made new.

sentences.zh: 祖述變通，正在今日。

translations.literal: Following the ancestors yet adapting to change — the moment is today.
translations.idiomatic: Following the ancestors yet adapting to change — the moment is today.

sentences.zh: 務施實德，不尚虛文。

translations.literal: We must apply solid virtue and not honor empty forms.
translations.idiomatic: We must apply solid virtue and not honor empty forms.

sentences.zh: 雖承平未易遽臻，而饑渴所當先務。

translations.literal: Though full peace cannot quickly be attained, thirst and hunger are what must first be addressed.
translations.idiomatic: Though full peace cannot quickly be attained, thirst and hunger are what must first be addressed.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 歷數攸歸，欽應上天之命；

translations.literal: The mandate of succession has returned — reverently we respond to Heaven's command.
translations.idiomatic: The mandate of succession has returned — reverently we respond to Heaven's command.

sentences.zh: 勛親斯托，敢忘烈祖之規？

translations.literal: Meritorious kin are entrusted to us — dare we forget the rule of the glorious ancestors?
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious kin are entrusted to us — dare we forget the rule of the glorious ancestors?

sentences.zh: 建極體元，與民更始。

translations.literal: Establish the supreme norm and renew the realm together with the people.
translations.idiomatic: Establish the supreme norm and renew the realm together with the people.

sentences.zh: 朕所不逮，更賴我遠近宗族、中外文武，同心協力，獻可替否之助也。

translations.literal: Where we fall short, we rely all the more on our kinsmen near and far, civil and military within and without, to join hearts and combine strength and offer counsel both approving and correcting.
translations.idiomatic: Where we fall short, we rely all the more on our kinsmen near and far, civil and military within and without, to join hearts and combine strength and offer counsel both approving and correcting.

sentences.zh: 誕告多方，體予至意！

translations.literal: Proclaim this widely in every quarter and embody our utmost sincerity!
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim this widely in every quarter and embody our utmost sincerity!

sentences.zh: 丁未，以翰林侍讀學士郝經為國信使，翰林待制何源、禮部郎中劉人傑副之，使於宋。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day Hao Jing, Hanlin Academician Reader, was made Chief Envoy; He Yuan, Hanlin Attendant Draftsman, and Liu Renjie, Director in the Ministry of Rites, were made Deputy Envoys, and they were sent to the Song.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Hao Jing, Hanlin academician reader, was made chief envoy; He Yuan, Hanlin attendant draftsman, and Liu Renjie, director in the Ministry of Rites, were made deputy envoys and sent to the Song.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，收輯中外官吏宣劄牌面。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day credentials and name plaques of officials within and without were collected.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day credentials and name plaques of officials within and without were collected.

sentences.zh: 遣帖木兒、李舜欽等行部，考課各路諸色工匠。

translations.literal: Temür, Li Shunqin, and others were sent on circuit inspection to examine artisans of every route and every category.
translations.idiomatic: Temür, Li Shunqin, and others were sent on circuit inspection to examine artisans of every route and every category.

sentences.zh: 置急遞鋪。

translations.literal: Express relay stations were established.
translations.idiomatic: Express relay stations were established.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，征諸道兵六千五百人赴京師宿衛。

translations.literal: On the yichou day six thousand five hundred troops from every circuit were summoned to the capital for palace guard duty.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day six thousand five hundred troops from every circuit were summoned to the capital for palace guard duty.

sentences.zh: 置互市於漣水軍，禁私商不得越境，犯者死。

translations.literal: Markets for mutual trade were established at Lianshui Army; private merchants were forbidden to cross borders — violators were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Markets for mutual trade were established at Lianshui Army; private merchants were forbidden to cross borders — violators were put to death.

sentences.zh: 是月，阿裏不哥僭號於和林城西按坦河。

translations.literal: That month Ariq Böke declared himself emperor west of the Altan River outside Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ariq Böke declared himself emperor west of the Altan River outside Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 召賈居貞、張儆、王煥、完顏愈乘傳赴闕。

translations.literal: Jia Juzhen, Zhang Wei, Wang Huan, and Wanyan Yu were summoned by post relay to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Juzhen, Zhang Wei, Wang Huan, and Wanyan Yu were summoned by post relay to audience.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，詔燕貼木兒、忙古帶節度黃河以西諸軍。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, wuchen, an edict ordered Yeshi Temür and Mangudai to command all armies west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the fifth month an edict ordered Yeshi Temür and Mangudai to command all armies west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，建元中統，詔曰：

translations.literal: On the bingxu day the era name Zhongtong was established. The edict read:
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the era name Zhongtong was established. The edict read:

sentences.zh: 詔安撫壽春府軍民。

translations.literal: An edict to reassure the army and people of Shouchun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to reassure the army and people of Shouchun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以阿裏不哥反，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day, because Ariq Böke had rebelled, an edict granted amnesty to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day, because Ariq Böke had rebelled, an edict granted amnesty to the realm.

sentences.zh: 乙未，立十路宣撫司：以賽典赤、李德輝為燕京路宣撫使，徐世隆副之；

translations.literal: On the yiwei day ten Pacification Offices were established: Sayid Ajall and Li Dehui as Pacification Commissioners of the Yanjing Route, with Xu Shilong as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day ten pacification offices were established: Sayid Ajall and Li Dehui as pacification commissioners of the Yanjing route, with Xu Shilong as deputy.

sentences.zh: 宋子貞為益都濟南等路宣撫使，王磐副之；

translations.literal: Song Zizhen as Pacification Commissioner of Yidu, Jinan, and other routes, with Wang Pan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zizhen as pacification commissioner of Yidu, Jinan, and other routes, with Wang Pan as deputy.

sentences.zh: 河南路經略使史天澤為河南宣撫使；

translations.literal: Shi Tianze, Frontier Commissioner of the Henan Route, as Pacification Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianze, frontier commissioner of the Henan route, as pacification commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 楊果為北京等路宣撫使，趙丙副之；

translations.literal: Yang Guo as Pacification Commissioner of the Beijing and other routes, with Zhao Bing as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guo as pacification commissioner of the Beijing and other routes, with Zhao Bing as deputy.

sentences.zh: 張德輝為平陽太原路宣撫使，謝瑄副之；

translations.literal: Zhang Dehui as Pacification Commissioner of the Pingyang-Taiyuan Route, with Xie Xuan as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dehui as pacification commissioner of the Pingyang-Taiyuan route, with Xie Xuan as deputy.

sentences.zh: 孛魯海牙、劉肅並為真定路宣撫使；

translations.literal: Bolqai and Liu Su both as Pacification Commissioners of the Zhending Route.
translations.idiomatic: Bolqai and Liu Su both as pacification commissioners of the Zhending route.

sentences.zh: 姚樞為東平路宣撫使，張肅副之；

translations.literal: Yao Shu as Pacification Commissioner of the Dongping Route, with Zhang Su as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shu as pacification commissioner of the Dongping route, with Zhang Su as deputy.

sentences.zh: 中書左丞張文謙為大名彰德等路宣撫使，遊顯副之；

translations.literal: Zhang Wenqian, Left Councillor of the Secretariat, as Pacification Commissioner of Daming, Zhangde, and other routes, with You Xian as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenqian, left councillor of the Secretariat, as pacification commissioner of Daming, Zhangde, and other routes, with You Xian as deputy.

sentences.zh: 粘合南合為西京路宣撫使，崔巨濟副之；

translations.literal: Nayanan as Pacification Commissioner of the Xijing Route, with Cui Juji as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Nayanan as pacification commissioner of the Xijing route, with Cui Juji as deputy.

sentences.zh: 廉希憲為京兆等路宣撫使。

translations.literal: Lian Xixian as Pacification Commissioner of the Jingzhao and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Xixian as pacification commissioner of the Jingzhao and other routes.

sentences.zh: 以汪惟正為鞏昌等處便宜都總帥，虎闌箕為鞏昌路元帥。

translations.literal: Wang Weizheng was made Provisional Supreme Commander of Gongchang and other places; Hulanchi was made Marshal of the Gongchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Weizheng was made provisional supreme commander of Gongchang and other places; Hulanchi was made marshal of the Gongchang route.

sentences.zh: 詔諭成都路侍郎張威安撫元、忠、綿、資、邛、彭等州，西川、潼川、隆慶、順慶等府及各處山寨歸附官吏，皆給宣命、金符有差。

translations.literal: An edict announced Vice Minister Zhang Wei of the Chengdu Route to pacify Yuan, Zhong, Mian, Zi, Qiong, Peng, and other prefectures and the prefectures and fortresses of Xichuan, Tongchuan, Longqing, Shunqing, and every mountain fortress that had submitted, all receiving credentials and gold tally tokens in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict announced Vice Minister Zhang Wei of the Chengdu route to pacify Yuan, Zhong, Mian, Zi, Qiong, Peng, and other prefectures and the prefectures and fortresses of Xichuan, Tongchuan, Longqing, Shunqing, and every mountain fortress that had submitted, all receiving credentials and gold tally tokens in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 詔平陽、京兆兩路宣撫司僉兵七千人，於延安等處守隘，以萬戶鄭鼎、昔剌忙古帶領之，貧不能應役者，官為資給。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Pacification Offices of the Pingyang and Jingzhao routes to levy seven thousand troops to hold the passes at Yan'an and other places, led by the commanders of ten thousand households Zheng Ding and Sira Mangudai; for those too poor to serve, the state would supply funds.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the pacification offices of the Pingyang and Jingzhao routes to levy seven thousand troops to hold the passes at Yan'an and other places, led by the commanders of ten thousand households Zheng Ding and Sira Mangudai; for those too poor to serve, the state would supply funds.

sentences.zh: 征諸路兵三萬駐燕京近地，命諸路市馬萬匹送開平府。

translations.literal: Thirty thousand troops from every route were summoned to encamp near Yanjing; every route was ordered to purchase ten thousand horses and send them to Kaiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty thousand troops from every route were summoned to encamp near Yanjing; every route was ordered to purchase ten thousand horses and send them to Kaiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以總帥汪良臣統陜西漢軍於沿河守隘。

translations.literal: The supreme commander Wang Liangchen was to command the Shaanxi Han army in holding the passes along the river.
translations.idiomatic: The supreme commander Wang Liangchen was to command the Shaanxi Han army in holding the passes along the river.

sentences.zh: 立望雲驛，非軍事毋得輒入。

translations.literal: Wangyun Post was established; none but military affairs might enter without cause.
translations.idiomatic: Wangyun Post was established; none but military affairs might enter without cause.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入南斗，留五十餘日。

translations.literal: Mars entered the Southern Dipper and remained more than fifty days.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Southern Dipper and remained more than fifty days.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，詔燕京、西京、北京三路宣撫司運米十萬石，輸開平府及撫州、沙井、凈州、魚兒濼，以備軍儲。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the sixth month an edict ordered the Pacification Offices of the Yanjing, Xijing, and Beijing routes to transport one hundred thousand shi of grain to Kaiping Prefecture and to Fu, Shajing, Jing, and Yur'er Bo to prepare military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the sixth month an edict ordered the pacification offices of the Yanjing, Xijing, and Beijing routes to transport one hundred thousand shi of grain to Kaiping Prefecture and to Fu, Shajing, Jing, and Yur'er Bo to prepare military stores.

sentences.zh: 以李亶為江淮大都督。

translations.literal: Li Tan was made Grand Commander of the Jiang-Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tan was made grand commander of the Jiang-Huai region.

sentences.zh: 劉太平等謀反，事覺伏誅，並誅乞帶不花於東川，明裏火者於西川。

translations.literal: Liu Taiping and others plotted rebellion; the affair was discovered and they were executed. Qidanbuqa was also executed in Dongchuan and Minglihuozhe in Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Taiping and others plotted rebellion; the affair was discovered and they were executed. Qidanbuqa was also executed in Dongchuan and Minglihuozhe in Xichuan.

sentences.zh: 渾都海反。

translations.literal: Qunduqai rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Qunduqai rebelled.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，李亶言：「獲宋諜者，言賈似道調兵，聲言攻漣州，遣人覘之，見許浦江口及射陽湖兵船二千艘，宜繕理城塹以備。

translations.literal: On the yisi day Li Tan reported: "We captured a Song spy who said Jia Sidao was mobilizing troops, declaring an attack on Lian Prefecture. We sent men to reconnoiter and saw two thousand warships at the mouth of the Xu River and at Sheyang Lake. The walls and moats ought to be repaired in preparation."
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Li Tan reported, "We captured a Song spy who said Jia Sidao was mobilizing troops, declaring an attack on Lian Prefecture. We sent men to reconnoiter and saw two thousand warships at the mouth of the Xu River and at Sheyang Lake. The walls and moats ought to be repaired in preparation."

sentences.zh: 」罷阿藍帶兒所簽解鹽戶軍百人。

translations.literal: The hundred salt-household troops conscripted by Alandai'er were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred salt-household troops conscripted by Alandai'er were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔陜西四川宣撫司八春節制諸軍。

translations.literal: On the renzi day an edict ordered Bachun of the Shaanxi-Sichuan Pacification Office to command all armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day an edict ordered Bachun of the Shaanxi-Sichuan pacification office to command all armies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔東平路萬戶嚴忠濟等發精兵一萬五千人赴開平。

translations.literal: On the yimao day an edict ordered Yan Zhongji and others, commanders of ten thousand households of the Dongping Route, to dispatch fifteen thousand elite troops to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict ordered Yan Zhongji and others, commanders of ten thousand households of the Dongping route, to dispatch fifteen thousand elite troops to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以石長不為大理國總管，佩虎符。

translations.literal: On the yichou day Shi Changbu was made Chief Administrator of the Dali Kingdom and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Shi Changbu was made chief administrator of the Dali kingdom and granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 詔十路宣撫司造戰襖、裘、帽，各以萬計，輸開平。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ten Pacification Offices to manufacture padded jackets, furs, and caps, each in numbers of ten thousand, and send them to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ten pacification offices to manufacture padded jackets, furs, and caps, each in numbers of ten thousand, and send them to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 是月，召真定劉郁，邢州郝子明，彰德胡祗遹，燕京馮渭、王光益、楊恕、李彥通、趙和之，東平韓文獻、張昉等，乘傳赴闕。

translations.literal: That month Liu Yu of Zhending, Hao Ziming of Xingzhou, Hu Zhiyuan of Zhangde, Feng Wei, Wang Guangyi, Yang Shu, Li Yantong, and Zhao Hezhi of Yanjing, Han Wenxian and Zhang Fang of Dongping, and others were summoned by post relay to audience.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liu Yu of Zhending, Hao Ziming of Xingzhou, Hu Zhiyuan of Zhangde, Feng Wei, Wang Guangyi, Yang Shu, Li Yantong, and Zhao Hezhi of Yanjing, Han Wenxian and Zhang Fang of Dongping, and others were summoned by post relay to audience.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王王倎遣其子永安公僖、判司宰事韓即來賀即位，以國王封冊、王印及虎符賜之。

translations.literal: King Tan of Goryeo sent his son the Duke of Yong'an, Xi, and Han Ki, Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, to congratulate the accession; the king's patent of enfeoffment, royal seal, and tiger tally were bestowed on him.
translations.idiomatic: King Tan of Goryeo sent his son the Duke of Yong'an, Xi, and Han Ki, vice director of the Ministry of Rites, to congratulate the accession; the king's patent of enfeoffment, royal seal, and tiger tally were bestowed on him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，敕燕京、北京、西京、真定、平陽、大名、東平、益都等路宣撫司，造羊裘、皮帽、褲、靴，皆以萬計，輸開平。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered the Pacification Offices of the Yanjing, Beijing, Xijing, Zhending, Pingyang, Daming, Dongping, Yidu, and other routes to manufacture sheepskin coats, fur caps, trousers, and boots, each in numbers of ten thousand, and send them to Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered the pacification offices of the Yanjing, Beijing, Xijing, Zhending, Pingyang, Daming, Dongping, Yidu, and other routes to manufacture sheepskin coats, fur caps, trousers, and boots, each in numbers of ten thousand, and send them to Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以萬戶史天澤扈從先帝有功，賜銀萬五千兩。

translations.literal: On the jisi day, because the commander of ten thousand households Shi Tianze had followed the late Emperor with merit, he was granted fifteen thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day, because the commander of ten thousand households Shi Tianze had followed the late Emperor with merit, he was granted fifteen thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 遣靈州種田民還京兆。

translations.literal: Farming households of Ling Prefecture were sent back to Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Farming households of Ling Prefecture were sent back to Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜山東行省大都督李亶金符二十、銀符五，俾給所部有功將士。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day Li Tan, Grand Commander of the Shandong Branch Secretariat, was granted twenty gold tally tokens and five silver tally tokens to reward meritorious officers under his command.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Li Tan, grand commander of the Shandong branch secretariat, was granted twenty gold tally tokens and five silver tally tokens to reward meritorious officers under his command.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以燕京路宣慰使祃祃行中書省事，燕京路宣慰使趙璧平章政事，張啟元參知政事，王鶚翰林學士承旨兼修國史，河南路宣撫使史天澤兼江淮諸翼軍馬經略使。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day Mamma, Pacification Commissioner of the Yanjing Route, was ordered to administer Secretariat affairs; Zhao Bi, Pacification Commissioner of the Yanjing Route, was made Grand Councillor; Zhang Qiyuan was made Vice Grand Councillor; Wang E was Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief and concurrently Compiler of the National History; Shi Tianze, Pacification Commissioner of the Henan Route, was concurrently Frontier Commissioner of the Jiang-Huai wing armies and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day Mamma, pacification commissioner of the Yanjing route, was ordered to administer Secretariat affairs; Zhao Bi, pacification commissioner of the Yanjing route, was made grand councillor; Zhang Qiyuan was made vice grand councillor; Wang E was Hanlin academician expositor-in-chief and concurrently compiler of the national history; Shi Tianze, pacification commissioner of the Henan route, was concurrently frontier commissioner of the Jiang-Huai wing armies and horses.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔中書省給諸王塔察兒益都、平州封邑歲賦、金帛，並以諸王白虎、襲剌門所屬民戶、人匠、歲賦給之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to grant Prince Tachar the annual tax and silks of his enfeoffment at Yidu and Ping Prefecture, and likewise to grant the households, artisans, and annual tax of the people belonging to the princes Baifu and Sirmen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Secretariat to grant Prince Tachar the annual tax and silks of his enfeoffment at Yidu and Ping Prefecture, and likewise to grant the households, artisans, and annual tax of the people belonging to the princes Baifu and Sirmen.

sentences.zh: 詔造中統元寶交鈔。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the manufacture of Zhongtong yuanbao paper notes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the manufacture of Zhongtong yuanbao paper notes.

sentences.zh: 立互市於潁州、漣水、光化軍。

translations.literal: Markets for mutual trade were established at Ying Prefecture, Lianshui, and Guanghua Army.
translations.idiomatic: Markets for mutual trade were established at Ying Prefecture, Lianshui, and Guanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 北京路都元帥阿海乞免所部軍士征徭，從之。

translations.literal: Ahai, Grand Marshal of the Beijing Route, asked exemption from corvée and tax for the soldiers under his command; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Ahai, grand marshal of the Beijing route, asked exemption from corvée and tax for the soldiers under his command; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 宋兵攻邊城，詔遣太尹、怯列、忙古帶率所部，合兵擊之。

translations.literal: Song troops attacked border cities; an edict dispatched Taiyin, Qielie, and Mangudai to lead their forces and join in striking them.
translations.idiomatic: When Song forces struck the border garrisons, the Emperor ordered Taiyin, Qielie, and Mangudai to combine their commands and drive them back.

sentences.zh: 下詔褒賞行省大都督李亶。

translations.literal: An edict was issued commending and rewarding Li Tan, Grand Governor of the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict went out praising and rewarding Li Tan, Grand Governor of the Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 帝自將討阿裏不哥。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally led a campaign against Ariq Böke.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor took the field in person to suppress Ariq Böke.

sentences.zh: 敕劉天麟規措中都析津驛傳馬。

translations.literal: Liu Tianlin was ordered to organize relay horses at the Zhongdu Xijin station.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tianlin was ordered to provision relay horses for the Xijin post station at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，授中書左丞、行大名等路宣撫使張文謙虎符。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, Zhang Wenqian, Left Associate of the Central Secretariat and Branch Pacification Commissioner for Daming and other circuits, was granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, Zhang Wenqian—Left Associate of the Central Secretariat and acting Pacification Commissioner for Daming and other circuits—was given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔都元帥紐璘所過毋擅捶掠官吏。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an edict forbade the Grand Marshal Niuchin from arbitrarily beating and plundering officials wherever he passed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict forbade Grand Marshal Niuchin to beat or plunder officials along his route.

sentences.zh: 己酉，立秦蜀行中書省，以京兆等路宣撫使廉希憲為中書省右丞，行省事。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the Branch Central Secretariat for Qin and Shu was established, with Lian Xixian, Pacification Commissioner for Jingzhao and other circuits, appointed Right Associate of the Central Secretariat to manage branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat was established, with Lian Xixian of the Jingzhao Pacification Commission made its Right Associate to conduct branch affairs.

sentences.zh: 宋兵臨漣州，李亶乞諸道援兵。

translations.literal: Song troops approached Lianzhou; Li Tan requested reinforcements from all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces pressed Lianzhou, and Li Tan asked every circuit for reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜必阇赤塔剌渾銀二千五百兩。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Targhun the bidchi was granted two thousand five hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial secretary Targhun received two thousand five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 李亶乞遣將益兵，渡淮攻宋，以方遣使修好，不從。

translations.literal: Li Tan requested that generals and additional troops be dispatched to cross the Huai and attack Song; because Song had just sent envoys seeking peace, this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tan asked for more generals and men to cross the Huai and strike Song, but the court refused—Song had only just sent envoys to reopen peace talks.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，澤州、潞州旱，民饑，敕賑之。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Ze and Lu Prefectures suffered drought and the people were hungry; relief was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day drought struck Ze and Lu Prefectures and the people went hungry; the court ordered relief.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，帝在轉都兒哥之地，以阿裏不哥遺命，下詔諭中外。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingmao day, the Emperor was at Tendüge; on Ariq Böke's testamentary order, an edict was issued to instruct the empire within and without.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao day, while the Emperor was at Tendüge, he issued an edict to the whole realm on the testamentary orders left by Ariq Böke.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李亶復請攻宋，復諭止之。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Li Tan again requested an attack on Song; he was again instructed to desist.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Li Tan again pressed for an attack on Song and was again told to hold back.

sentences.zh: 壬午，初置拱衛儀仗。

translations.literal: On renwu day, the Palace Guard ceremonial escort was first established.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Palace Guard ceremonial escort was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 是月，阿藍答兒率兵至西涼府，與渾都海軍合，詔諸王合丹、合必赤與總帥汪良臣等率師討之。

translations.literal: That month, Arigh Buqa led troops to Xiliang Prefecture, joined Qunduqai's army, and an edict ordered Princes Qotan, Qebek, and Grand Marshal Wang Liangchen and others to lead armies to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Arigh Buqa marched to Xiliang Prefecture and joined Qunduqai's force; the Emperor ordered Princes Qotan and Qebek, Grand Marshal Wang Liangchen, and others to take the field against them.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大敗其軍於姑臧，斬阿藍答兒及渾都海，西土悉平。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, their army was greatly defeated at Guzang; Arigh Buqa and Qunduqai were beheaded, and the western lands were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day their army was shattered at Guzang; Arigh Buqa and Qunduqai were executed, and the western regions were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，李亶言宋兵復軍於漣州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei day, Li Tan reported that Song troops had regrouped at Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei day, Li Tan reported that Song forces had massed again at Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，初行中統寶鈔。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the Zhongtong treasure notes were first put into circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Zhongtong treasure notes entered circulation for the first time.

sentences.zh: 戊午，車駕駐昔光之地，命給官錢，雇在京橐駝，運米萬石，輸行在所。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the imperial carriage halted at Xiguang; official funds were ordered to hire camels in the capital to transport ten thousand shi of grain to the temporary palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court halted at Xiguang and ordered official funds used to hire camels in the capital to haul ten thousand shi of grain to the temporary palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，發常平倉賑益都、濟南、濱棣饑民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuzi day, grain from the Ever-Normal Granaries was released to relieve the hungry in Yidu, Jinan, and Bin-Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi day, grain from the Ever-Normal Granaries was opened to feed the hungry in Yidu, Jinan, and Bin-Di.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，以禮部郎中孟甲、禮部員外郎李文俊使安南、大理。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingshen day, Meng Jia, Director in the Ministry of Rites, and Li Wenjun, Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites, were sent as envoys to Annam and Dali.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingshen day, Meng Jia and Li Wenjun of the Ministry of Rites were dispatched as envoys to Annam and Dali.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，李亶上將士功，命亶以益都官銀賞之。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Li Tan submitted a register of officers' and soldiers' merit; he was ordered to reward them with official silver from Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Li Tan submitted the rolls of his officers' and soldiers' achievements and was ordered to pay them from Yidu's official silver.

sentences.zh: 帝至自和林，駐蹕燕京近郊。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned from Qara Qorum and halted near the outskirts of Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returned from Qara Qorum and encamped near Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 始制祭享太廟祭器、法服。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels and ritual robes for offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple were first made.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels and court robes for the Imperial Ancestral Temple were commissioned for the first time.

sentences.zh: 以梵僧八合思八為帝師，授以玉印，統釋教。

translations.literal: 'Phags-pa, a Buddhist monk of the Sakya school, was made Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and put in charge of the Buddhist clergy.
translations.idiomatic: 'Phags-pa the Sakya monk was made Imperial Preceptor, given a jade seal, and placed at the head of the Buddhist clergy.

sentences.zh: 立仙音院，復改為玉宸院，括樂工。

translations.literal: The Immortal Music Bureau was established, then renamed the Jade Court Bureau, and musicians were registered.
translations.idiomatic: The Immortal Music Bureau was established, later renamed the Jade Court Bureau, and musicians were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 立儀鳳司，又立符寶局及禦酒庫、群牧所。

translations.literal: The Ceremonial Phoenix Office was established, and the Seal and Treasure Bureau, the Imperial Wine Storehouse, and the Herd Office were also established.
translations.idiomatic: The Ceremonial Phoenix Office was established, along with the Seal and Treasure Bureau, the Imperial Wine Storehouse, and the Herd Office.

sentences.zh: 升衛輝為總管府。

translations.literal: Weihui was promoted to a General Directorate Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui was elevated to a General Directorate Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 賜親王穆哥銀二千五百兩；

translations.literal: Prince Möge was granted two thousand five hundred taels of silver;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Möge received two thousand five hundred taels of silver;

sentences.zh: 諸王按只帶、忽剌忽兒、合丹、忽剌出、勝納合兒銀各五千兩，文綺帛各三百匹，金素半之；

translations.literal: Princes Azhan, Qolqolus, Qotan, Qolchu, and Senaqer each five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts each of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that amount;
translations.idiomatic: Princes Azhan, Qolqolus, Qotan, Qolchu, and Senaqer each received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 諸王塔察、阿術魯鈔各五十九錠有奇，綿五千九十八斤，絹五千九十八匹，文綺三百匹，金素半之；

translations.literal: Princes Taqachar and Arsluq each fifty-nine odd ingots of paper money, five thousand ninety-eight jin of cotton, five thousand ninety-eight bolts of silk, three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that amount;
