translations.idiomatic: Princes Taqachar and Arsluq each received fifty-nine-odd ingots of paper money, five thousand ninety-eight jin of cotton, five thousand ninety-eight bolts of silk, and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 海都銀八百三十三兩，文綺五十匹，金素半之；

translations.literal: Qaidu eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver and fifty bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that amount;
translations.idiomatic: Qaidu received eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver and fifty bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 睹兒赤、也不幹銀八百五十兩；

translations.literal: Töröchi and Yebuqan eight hundred fifty taels of silver each;
translations.idiomatic: Töröchi and Yebuqan each received eight hundred fifty taels of silver;

sentences.zh: 兀魯忽帶銀五千兩，文綺三百匹，金素半之；

translations.literal: Ulughtai five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that amount;
translations.idiomatic: Ulughtai received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 只必帖木兒銀八百三十三兩；

translations.literal: Jibtemür eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver;
translations.idiomatic: Jibtemür received eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver;

sentences.zh: 爪都、伯木兒銀五千兩，文綺三百匹，金素半之；

translations.literal: Jadu and Bömür five thousand taels of silver each and three hundred bolts of patterned silk each, with plain silk at half that amount;
translations.idiomatic: Jadu and Bömür each received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 都魯、牙忽銀八百三十三兩，特賜綿五十斤；

translations.literal: Döru and Yaqhu eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver each, with a special grant of fifty jin of cotton;
translations.idiomatic: Döru and Yaqhu each received eight hundred thirty-three taels of silver, with an additional grant of fifty jin of cotton;

sentences.zh: 阿只吉銀五千兩，文綺三百，金素半之；

translations.literal: Ajigi five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that amount;
translations.idiomatic: Ajigi received five thousand taels of silver and three hundred bolts of patterned silk, with plain silk at half that measure;

sentences.zh: 先朝皇后怗古倫銀二千五百兩，羅絨等折寶鈔二十三錠有奇；

translations.literal: The former empress Tegülen two thousand five hundred taels of silver and twenty-three odd ingots of treasure notes converted from brocade and velvet;
translations.idiomatic: The former empress Tegülen received two thousand five hundred taels of silver and twenty-three-odd ingots of treasure notes reckoned from brocade and velvet;

sentences.zh: 皇后斡者思銀二千五百兩；

translations.literal: Empress Oqojin two thousand five hundred taels of silver;
translations.idiomatic: Empress Oqojin received two thousand five hundred taels of silver;

sentences.zh: 兀魯忽乃妃子銀五千兩。

translations.literal: Ulughtai's consort five thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Ulughtai's consort received five thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: Henceforth this became the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth these grants became an annual custom.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛未夜，東北赤氣照人，大如席。

translations.literal: In the second year, on the night of xinwei in the first month of spring, a red glow in the northeast lit the sky, as large as a mat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the xinwei night of the first spring month, a red glow in the northeast filled the sky, broad as a mat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，宋兵圍漣州。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Song troops besieged Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Song forces besieged Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，李亶率將士迎戰，敗之，賜詔獎諭，給金銀符以賞將士。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Li Tan led officers and soldiers to meet them in battle, defeated them, and was rewarded with an edict of commendation and gold and silver tally tokens for his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Li Tan led his officers and men out to meet them, routed them, and received an edict of praise together with gold and silver tally tokens for his troops.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，亶擅發兵修益都城塹。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Tan on his own authority mobilized troops to repair the moat of Yidu city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Li Tan, on his own authority, raised troops to repair the moat around Yidu.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，太陰掩昴。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingyou day, the moon occulted the Pleiades.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingyou day, the moon passed before the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 己亥，宋兵攻漣水，命阿術等帥兵赴之。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Song troops attacked Lianshui; Aju and others were ordered to lead troops there.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Song forces attacked Lianshui, and Aju and others were ordered to march to its relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕幸開平。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor visited Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 詔減免民間差發，罷守隘諸軍。

translations.literal: An edict reduced and remitted corvée levies on the people and disbanded the garrison troops holding the passes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict cut corvée levies on the people and stood down the garrisons holding the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 秦蜀行省借民錢給軍，以今年稅賦償之。

translations.literal: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat borrowed money from the people to pay the army, to be repaid from this year's tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat borrowed from the people to pay the army, promising repayment from that year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 免平陽、太原軍站戶重科租稅。

translations.literal: Heavy additional rent and tax on military relay households in Pingyang and Taiyuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The heavy extra rents and taxes imposed on military relay households in Pingyang and Taiyuan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔行中書省平章祃祃及王文統等率各路宣撫使赴闕。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an edict ordered Möngke, Wang Wengtong, and other Grand Councillors of the Branch Central Secretariat to lead the circuit Pacification Commissioners to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court ordered Grand Councillor Möngke, Wang Wengtong, and the other branch secretariat ministers to bring the circuit Pacification Commissioners to court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，李亶破宋兵於沙湖堰。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Li Tan defeated Song troops at the Shahu weir.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Li Tan routed Song forces at the Shahu weir.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the renxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu new moon of the third month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，詔軍中所俘儒士聽贖為民。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu day, an edict allowed Confucian scholars taken captive in the armies to ransom themselves and return to civilian status.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingwu day, an edict permitted Confucian scholars captured in the armies to buy their way back to civilian life.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣弓工往教鄯闡人為弓。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, bow-makers were sent to teach the people of Dian bow-craft.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day bow-makers were sent to teach the people of Dian how to make bows.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔十路宣撫使量免民間課程。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict ordered the Pacification Commissioners of the ten circuits to reduce the people's tax levies as circumstances allowed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Pacification Commissioners of the ten circuits were ordered to reduce the people's tax levies as local conditions allowed.

sentences.zh: 命宣撫司官勸農桑，抑遊惰，禮高年，問民疾苦，舉文學才識可以從政及茂才異等，列名上聞，以聽擢用；

translations.literal: Pacification officials were ordered to encourage farming and sericulture, restrain idleness, honor the aged, inquire into the people's hardships, and recommend men of literary learning and talent fit for office and men of outstanding ability, submitting their names for promotion;
translations.idiomatic: Pacification officials were charged to promote farming and sericulture, curb idleness, honor the aged, inquire into popular hardship, and recommend men of learning and talent fit for office and men of outstanding ability, submitting their names for appointment;

sentences.zh: 其職官汙濫及民不孝悌者，量輕重議罰。

translations.literal: officials guilty of abuse and people lacking filial piety and brotherliness were to be punished according to the gravity of the offense.
translations.idiomatic: while corrupt officials and people lacking filial piety or brotherliness were to be punished according to the gravity of the offense.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔太康弩軍二千八百人戍蔡州。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, an edict ordered twenty-eight hundred crossbow troops of Taikang to garrison Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day two thousand eight hundred crossbow troops of Taikang were ordered to garrison Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 以禮部郎中劉芳使大理等國。

translations.literal: Liu Fang, Director in the Ministry of Rites, was sent as envoy to Dali and other states.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fang of the Ministry of Rites was dispatched as envoy to Dali and other states.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，禁使臣毋入民家，令止頓析津驛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou day, envoys were forbidden to enter private homes; they were ordered to stop only at the Xijin relay station.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou day, envoys were forbidden to enter private homes and were required to lodge only at the Xijin relay station.

sentences.zh: 遣崔明道、李全義為詳問官，詣宋淮東制司，訪問國信使郝經等所在，仍以稽留信使、侵擾疆場詰之。

translations.literal: Cui Mingdao and Li Quanyi were sent as inquiry commissioners to the Song Huaidong Commandery office to ask after the whereabouts of the imperial envoy Hao Jing and others, and also to press charges of detaining envoys and violating the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Mingdao and Li Quanyi were sent as inquiry commissioners to the Song Huaidong headquarters to demand the whereabouts of the imperial envoy Hao Jing and his party, and to rebuke the Song for detaining envoys and violating the border.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，敕使臣及軍士所過城邑，官給廩餼，毋擾於民。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, an edict ordered that wherever envoys and soldiers passed through walled towns, the officials should supply provisions and they must not disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the court ordered that envoys and soldiers passing through towns were to be fed at public expense and must not trouble the people.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，申嚴沿邊軍民越境私商之禁。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the prohibition on frontier soldiers and civilians crossing the border to trade privately was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the ban on frontier soldiers and civilians crossing the border to trade privately was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 唐慶子政臣入見，詔復其家。

translations.literal: Tang Qing's son Zheng Chen came to audience; an edict restored his family.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Chen, son of Tang Qing, came to audience, and an edict restored his family's standing.

sentences.zh: 弛諸路山澤之禁。

translations.literal: Prohibitions on mountains and marshes in all circuits were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: Restrictions on use of mountains and marshes throughout the circuits were lifted.

sentences.zh: 禁私殺馬牛。

translations.literal: Private slaughter of horses and cattle was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Private slaughter of horses and cattle was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 申嚴越境私商，販馬匹者罪死。

translations.literal: The ban on cross-border private trade was strictly enforced; those who trafficked in horses were punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on cross-border private trade was tightened: horse-traffickers were punished with death.

sentences.zh: 以河南經略宣撫使史天澤為中書右丞相，河南軍民並聽節制。

translations.literal: Shi Tianze, Pacification Commissioner and Military Commissioner of Henan, was made Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat, with Henan's soldiers and civilians all under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianze, Pacification and Military Commissioner of Henan, was made Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat, with all Henan's soldiers and civilians placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 詔成都路置惠民藥局。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the establishment of a Public Pharmacy in Chengdu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a Public Pharmacy established in Chengdu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 遣王祐於西川等路采訪醫、儒、僧、道。

translations.literal: Wang You was sent to the Xichuan and other circuits to seek out physicians, Confucians, monks, and Daoists.
translations.idiomatic: Wang You was sent through Xichuan and other circuits to seek out physicians, Confucians, monks, and Daoists.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，括漏籍老幼等戶，協濟編戶賦稅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guisi day, unregistered elderly and young households were enrolled to share the tax burden of registered households.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi day, unregistered elderly and young households were enrolled to help registered households meet their tax obligations.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜新附人王顯忠、王誼等衣物有差。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the newly submitted Wang Xianzhong, Wang Yi, and others were granted clothing in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the newly submitted Wang Xianzhong, Wang Yi, and others received grants of clothing in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 李亶遣人獻漣水捷。

translations.literal: Li Tan sent men to report the victory at Lianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tan sent messengers to report the victory at Lianshui.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路拘收孛蘭奚。

translations.literal: The seizure of Qarluq people in all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The round-up of Qarluq people in all circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 禁諸王擅遣使招民及征私錢。

translations.literal: Princes were forbidden to send envoys on their own authority to recruit people or levy private funds.
translations.idiomatic: Princes were forbidden to dispatch envoys on their own authority to recruit people or levy private funds.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯角。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the moon passed through the Horn constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon entered the Horn constellation.

sentences.zh: 詔諭十路宣撫司並管民官，定鹽酒稅課等法。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the Pacification Commissions of the ten circuits to supervise civilian officials and fix laws for salt, wine, and commercial taxes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed the ten circuit Pacification Commissions to supervise civilian officials and set laws for salt, wine, and commercial taxes.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以嚴忠範為東平路行軍萬戶兼管民總管，仍諭東平路達魯花赤等官並聽節制。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Yan Zhongfan was made Field Myriarch of Dongping Circuit and concurrently Civilian Administrator; the darughachi and other officials of Dongping Circuit were also instructed to obey his command.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Yan Zhongfan was made Field Myriarch of Dongping Circuit and concurrently Civilian Administrator, and Dongping's darughachi and other officials were ordered to obey him.

sentences.zh: 詔定中外官所乘馬數各有差。

translations.literal: An edict fixed the number of horses officials within and without the court might ride, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed how many horses officials at court and in the provinces might keep, according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，賑火少裏驛戶之乏食者。

translations.literal: On yisi day, relay households at Huoshaoli short of food were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day relay households at Huoshaoli who lacked food received relief.

sentences.zh: 賞欽察所部將校有功者銀二千五百兩及幣帛有差。

translations.literal: Officers of Qincha's command who had won merit were rewarded with two thousand five hundred taels of silver and cloth and silk in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Officers under Qincha who had won distinction were rewarded with two thousand five hundred taels of silver and varying grants of cloth and silk.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命竇默仍翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Dou Mo was ordered to remain Hanlin Attendant Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Dou Mo was confirmed as Hanlin Attendant Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 默與王鶚面論王文統不宜在相位，薦許衡代之，帝不懌而罷。

translations.literal: Mo argued face to face with Wang E that Wang Wengtong was unfit for the chief ministership and recommended Xu Heng to replace him; the Emperor was displeased and dismissed the session.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Mo argued before Wang E that Wang Wengtong was unfit for the chief ministership and recommended Xu Heng in his place; the Emperor took offense and cut the audience short.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，轉懿州米萬石賑親王塔察兒所部饑民。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, ten thousand shi of grain from Yizhou was transferred to relieve the hungry among Prince Taqachar's followers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day ten thousand shi of grain from Yizhou was sent to feed the hungry among Prince Taqachar's followers.

sentences.zh: 賜親王合丹所部軍幣帛九百匹、布千九百匹。

translations.literal: Prince Qotan's army was granted nine hundred bolts of cloth and silk and one thousand nine hundred bolts of plain cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qotan's army received nine hundred bolts of cloth and silk and one thousand nine hundred bolts of plain cloth.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敕平陽路安邑縣蒲萄酒自今毋貢。

translations.literal: On yimao day, an edict ordered that grape wine of Anyi County, Pingyang Circuit, was no longer to be sent as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court ordered that grape wine from Anyi County in Pingyang Circuit was no longer to be sent as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔：「宣聖廟及管內書院，有司歲時致祭，月朔釋奠，禁諸官員使臣軍馬，毋得侵擾褻瀆，違者加罪。

translations.literal: An edict said: "At the Temple of the Sage and the academies under its jurisdiction, officials shall perform seasonal sacrifices and monthly offerings; all officials, envoys, and military horses are forbidden to intrude or profane the site—violators shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "At the Temple of the Sage and its affiliated academies, officials shall perform seasonal sacrifices and monthly offerings; no official, envoy, or military horse may intrude upon or profane the grounds—violators will be punished.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，以汪良臣同簽鞏昌路便宜都總帥，凡軍民官並聽良臣節制。

translations.literal: " On bingchen day, Wang Liangchen was made co-signatory of the Qinchang Circuit Expedient Grand Marshal's office; all military and civilian officials were to obey Liangchen's command.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingchen day Wang Liangchen was made co-signatory of the Qinchang Circuit Expedient Grand Marshal's office, with all military and civilian officials placed under his command.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敕諸路造人馬甲及鐵裝具萬二千，輸開平。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered all circuits to manufacture twelve thousand sets of human armor, horse armor, and iron fittings and deliver them to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day all circuits were ordered to manufacture twelve thousand sets of infantry armor, cavalry armor, and iron fittings and send them to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔毋收衛輝、懷孟賦稅，以償其所借芻粟。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, an edict ordered that taxes of Weihui and Huaimeng not be collected, to repay fodder and grain they had borrowed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court ordered that Weihui and Huaimeng be excused their taxes to repay borrowed fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 庚申，宋瀘州安撫使劉整舉城降，以整行夔府路中書省兼安撫使，佩虎符。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Liu Zheng, Pacification Commissioner of Luzhou in Song, surrendered the city; Zheng was made Branch Secretariat Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner of Kuifu Circuit and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Liu Zheng, Song Pacification Commissioner of Luzhou, surrendered the city; he was made Branch Secretariat Commissioner and Pacification Commissioner of Kuifu Circuit and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 仍諭都元帥紐璘等使存恤其民。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Niuchin and others were also instructed to care for and comfort the people.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Niuchin and others were also ordered to care for the people.

sentences.zh: 賜故金翰林修撰魏璠謚靖肅。

translations.literal: The posthumous title Jingsu was granted to Wei Fan, former Hanlin Compiler of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title Jingsu was conferred on Wei Fan, former Hanlin Compiler under the Jin.

sentences.zh: 秦蜀行省言青居山都元帥欽察等所部將校有功，詔降虎符一、金符五、銀符五十七，令行省銓定職名給之。

translations.literal: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat reported that officers under Qincha, Grand Marshal of Qingju Mountain, and others had won merit; an edict granted one tiger tally, five gold tallies, and fifty-seven silver tallies, ordering the branch secretariat to fix ranks and titles and issue them.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin-Shu Branch Secretariat reported merit won by officers under Grand Marshal Qincha of Qingju Mountain and others; the court granted one tiger tally, five gold tallies, and fifty-seven silver tallies and ordered the branch secretariat to fix ranks and issue them.

sentences.zh: 城臨洮。

translations.literal: The walls of Lintao were built.
translations.idiomatic: The walls of Lintao were built.

sentences.zh: 升真定鼓城縣為晉州，以鼓城、安平、武強、饒陽隸焉。

translations.literal: Gucheng County in Zhending was promoted to Jin Prefecture, with Gucheng, Anping, Wuqiang, and Raoyang placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: Gucheng County in Zhending was elevated to Jin Prefecture, with Gucheng, Anping, Wuqiang, and Raoyang placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 賜僧子聰懷孟、邢州田各五十頃。

translations.literal: The monk Zikai was granted fifty qing of fields each in Huaimeng and Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Zikai received fifty qing of fields each in Huaimeng and Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 罷金、銀、銅、鐵、丹粉、錫碌坑冶所役民夫及河南舞陽姜戶、藤花戶，還之州縣。

translations.literal: Laborers conscripted for gold, silver, copper, iron, cinnabar, and tin mines and smelters, and the ginger households and rattan-flower households of Wuyang in Henan, were released and returned to their prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Laborers conscripted for gold, silver, copper, iron, cinnabar, and tin mines, and the ginger and rattan-flower households of Wuyang in Henan, were released back to their prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 賜大理國主段實虎符，優詔撫諭之。

translations.literal: Duan Shi, king of Dali, was granted a tiger tally and comforted with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Shi, king of Dali, received a tiger tally and was comforted with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 命李亶領益都路鹽課。

translations.literal: Li Tan was ordered to administer the salt levy of Yidu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tan was put in charge of the salt levy of Yidu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 出工局繡女，聽其婚嫁。

translations.literal: Embroiderers in the craft bureau were released and allowed to marry.
translations.idiomatic: Embroiderers held in the craft bureau were released and permitted to marry.

sentences.zh: 懷孟廣濟渠提舉王允中、大使楊端仁鑿沁河渠成，溉田四百六十餘所。

translations.literal: Wang Yunzhong, Commissioner of the Huaimeng Guangji Canal, and Grand Ambassador Yang Duanren completed the Qin River canal, irrigating more than four hundred sixty estates.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yunzhong, Commissioner of the Huaimeng Guangji Canal, and Grand Ambassador Yang Duanren finished the Qin River canal, irrigating more than four hundred sixty estates.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王倎更名禃，遣其世子愖奉表來朝，命宿衛將軍孛裏察、禮部郎中高逸民持詔往諭，仍以玉帶賜之。

translations.literal: The king of Goryeo, formerly Jeon, changed his name to Chung; he sent his heir Tan with a memorial to court; the Palace Guard General Borichaq and Director in the Ministry of Rites Gao Yimin were ordered to carry an edict to instruct him, and a jade belt was also granted.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo, formerly called Jeon, took the name Chung and sent his heir Tan with a memorial to court; Palace Guard General Borichaq and Gao Yimin of the Ministry of Rites were sent with an edict to instruct him, and a jade belt was granted besides.

sentences.zh: 以不花為中書右丞相，耶律鑄為中書左丞相，張啟元為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Buqa was made Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat, Yelü Zhuo Left Grand Councillor, and Zhang Qiyuan Right Associate.
translations.idiomatic: Buqa was made Right Grand Councillor of the Central Secretariat, Yelü Zhuo Left Grand Councillor, and Zhang Qiyuan Right Associate.

sentences.zh: 授管領崇慶府、黎、雅、威、茂、邛、灌七處軍民小太尉虎符。

translations.literal: The Lesser Captain commanding the military and civilians of Chongqing Prefecture and the seven districts of Li, Ya, Wei, Mao, Qiong, and Guan was granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: The Lesser Captain in charge of the military and civilians of Chongqing Prefecture and the seven districts of Li, Ya, Wei, Mao, Qiong, and Guan received a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，立軍儲都轉運使司，以馬月合乃為使，周鍇為副使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinyou new moon, the Directorate of Military Grain Transport was established, with Mayuqanai as Commissioner and Zhou Kai as Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the seventh autumn month the Directorate of Military Grain Transport was established, with Mayuqanai as Commissioner and Zhou Kai as Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，初立翰林國史院。

translations.literal: On guihai day, the Hanlin Academy and National History Office were first established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Hanlin Academy and National History Office were established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 王鶚請修遼、金二史，又言：「唐太宗置弘文館，宋太宗設內外學士院。

translations.literal: Wang E requested that the histories of Liao and Jin be compiled, and also said: "Emperor Taizong of Tang established the Hongwen Hall, and Emperor Taizong of Song established the inner and outer academies of scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E asked that the histories of Liao and Jin be compiled, and argued: "Emperor Taizong of Tang established the Hongwen Hall, and Emperor Taizong of Song established the inner and outer academies of scholars.

sentences.zh: 今宜除拜學士院官，作養人才。

translations.literal: Now it is fitting to appoint academy scholars and cultivate talent.
translations.idiomatic: It is time to appoint academy scholars and cultivate talent.

sentences.zh: 乞以右丞相史天澤監修國史，左丞相耶律鑄、平章政事王文統監修《遼》、《金史》，仍采訪遺事。

translations.literal: I request that Right Grand Councillor Shi Tianze supervise the compilation of the national history, and Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo and Grand Councillor Wang Wengtong supervise the compilation of the Histories of Liao and Jin, while also gathering lost records.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Right Grand Councillor Shi Tianze supervise the national history, and Left Grand Councillor Yelü Zhuo and Grand Councillor Wang Wengtong supervise the Histories of Liao and Jin, while also gathering lost records.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " All was approved.

sentences.zh: 賑和林饑民。

translations.literal: The hungry in Qara Qorum were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: The hungry in Qara Qorum received relief.

sentences.zh: 賞鞏昌路總帥汪惟正將校斬渾都海功銀二千五百兩、馬價銀四千九百兩。

translations.literal: Officers of Qinchang Circuit Grand Marshal Wang Weizheng who had beheaded Qunduqai were rewarded with two thousand five hundred taels of silver and four thousand nine hundred taels of silver for horse prices.
translations.idiomatic: Officers under Qinchang Circuit Grand Marshal Wang Weizheng who had killed Qunduqai were rewarded with two thousand five hundred taels of silver and four thousand nine hundred taels for horse prices.

sentences.zh: 諸王昌童招河南漏籍戶五百，命付之有司。

translations.literal: Prince Changtong recruited five hundred unregistered households in Henan; they were ordered handed over to the proper offices.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Changtong recruited five hundred unregistered households in Henan; the court ordered them handed over to the proper offices.

sentences.zh: 命總管王青制神臂弓、柱子弓。

translations.literal: Administrator Wang Qing was ordered to manufacture divine-arm bows and pillar bows.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator Wang Qing was ordered to manufacture divine-arm bows and pillar bows.

sentences.zh: 諭河南管軍官於近城地量存牧場，余聽民耕。

translations.literal: Military officials of Henan were instructed to set aside pasture lands near the cities as needed; the remainder was to be opened to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's military officials were told to reserve pasture near the cities as needed and leave the rest open to farming.

sentences.zh: 巴思答兒乞於高麗鴨綠江西立互市，從之。

translations.literal: Basidar requested that a market be established west of the Yalu River in Goryeo; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Basidar asked to establish a market west of the Yalu in Goryeo, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣使持香幣祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: On yichou day, envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice to the sacred mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day envoys were sent with incense and silks to sacrifice to the sacred mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，渡江新附民留屯蔡州者，徙居懷孟，貸其種食。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, newly submitted people who had crossed the river and remained garrisoned at Caizhou were moved to Huaimeng and loaned seed and food.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day newly submitted people who had crossed the river and been kept at Caizhou were resettled in Huaimeng and loaned seed and food.

sentences.zh: 以萬家奴為安撫高麗軍民達魯花赤，賜虎符。

translations.literal: Wanjianu was made darughachi for the pacification of Goryeo's soldiers and civilians and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Wanjianu was made darughachi for the pacification of Goryeo's soldiers and civilians and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，西京、宣德隕霜殺稼。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, frost in Xijing and Xuande killed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day frost in Xijing and Xuande destroyed the crops.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔許衡即其家教懷孟生徒。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict allowed Xu Heng to teach students of Huaimeng in his home.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Xu Heng was permitted to teach Huaimeng students in his own home.

sentences.zh: 命西京宣撫司造船備西夏漕運。

translations.literal: The Xijing Pacification Commission was ordered to build ships to prepare grain transport for Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: The Xijing Pacification Commission was ordered to build ships for grain transport to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣納速剌丁、孟甲等使安南。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Nasir al-Din, Meng Jia, and others were sent as envoys to Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Nasir al-Din, Meng Jia, and others were dispatched as envoys to Annam.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以牛驛雨雪，道途泥濘，改立水驛。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, because ox relay stations were blocked by rain and snow and the roads were muddy, water relay stations were established instead.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, because rain and snow had mired the ox relay routes, water relay stations were established instead.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命煉師王道婦於真定築道觀，賜名玉華。

translations.literal: On jichou day, the Daoist priestess Wang Daofu was ordered to build a temple in Zhending; it was granted the name Yuhua.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Daoist priestess Wang Daofu was ordered to build a temple in Zhending; it was named Yuhua.

sentences.zh: 諭將士舉兵攻宋，詔曰：「朕即位之後，深以戢兵為念，故年前遣使於宋以通和好。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers were instructed to raise armies and attack Song; the edict said: "Since I ascended the throne I have deeply wished to still the armies, and so last year I sent envoys to Song to open friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers were ordered to take the field against Song; the edict read: "Since my accession I have deeply wished to still the armies, and so last year I sent envoys to Song to reopen friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 宋人不務遠圖，伺我小隙，反啟邊釁，東剽西掠，曾無寧日。

translations.literal: The Song did not look to the long view; watching for a small opening of ours, they reopened border hostilities, raiding east and west without a day of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Song did not look to the long view; watching for the smallest opening, they reopened the border war, raiding east and west until there was no day of peace.

sentences.zh: 朕今春還宮，諸大臣皆以舉兵南伐為請，朕重以兩國生靈之故，猶待信使還歸，庶有悛心，以成和議，留而不至者，今又半載矣。

translations.literal: This spring, when I returned to the palace, all the great ministers asked that armies be raised for a southern campaign; out of regard for the lives of both nations' people, I still waited for the envoys to return, hoping they might repent and a peace be concluded—but those who did not come have now been gone half a year.
translations.idiomatic: This spring, when I returned to court, my ministers all urged a southern campaign; out of regard for the lives of both peoples I still waited for the envoys to return, hoping Song might repent and peace be made—but those who never came have now been absent half a year.

sentences.zh: 往來之禮遽絕，侵擾之暴不已。

translations.literal: Courtesies of exchange were abruptly cut off, and violent incursions did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Courtesies of exchange were abruptly cut off, and raids did not cease.

sentences.zh: 彼嘗以衣冠禮樂之國自居，理當如是乎？

translations.literal: They once styled themselves a land of rites, robes, and music—is this how such a land should behave?
translations.idiomatic: They styled themselves a land of rites, robes, and music—is this how such a land behaves?

sentences.zh: 曲直之分，灼然可見。

translations.literal: The right and wrong of the matter are plainly visible.
translations.idiomatic: Right and wrong in the matter are plain for all to see.

sentences.zh: 今遣王道貞往諭。

translations.literal: Now Wang Daozhen is sent to instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wang Daozhen is sent to instruct them.

sentences.zh: 卿等當整爾士卒，礪爾戈矛，矯爾弓矢，約會諸將，秋高馬肥，水陸分道而進，以為問罪之舉。

translations.literal: You must ready your soldiers, sharpen your spears, straighten your bows and arrows, assemble the generals, and when autumn is high and horses are fat, advance by land and water in separate columns as a punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Ready your soldiers, sharpen your spears, straighten your bows, assemble the generals, and when autumn is high and horses are fat, advance by land and water in separate columns on a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 尚賴宗廟社稷之靈，其克有勛。

translations.literal: We still rely on the spirits of the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain—may success be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: We still rely on the spirits of the ancestral temple and the altars of soil and grain—may success attend you.

sentences.zh: 卿等當宣布朕心，明諭將士，各當自勉，毋替朕命。

translations.literal: You must proclaim my intent, clearly instruct the officers and soldiers, each exert himself, and not fail my command.
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim my intent, instruct the officers and soldiers clearly, let each exert himself, and do not fail my command.

sentences.zh: 」鄂州青山磯、滸黃洲所招新民遷至江北者，設官領之。

translations.literal: " Newly submitted people recruited at Qingshanji and Huhuangzhou in E Prefecture and moved north of the river were placed under appointed officials.
translations.idiomatic: " Newly submitted people recruited at Qingshanji and Huhuangzhou in E Prefecture and resettled north of the river were placed under appointed officials.

sentences.zh: 敕懷孟牧地聽民耕墾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that pasture lands in Huaimeng be opened to farming.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture lands in Huaimeng were opened to farming.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，賜故金補闕李大節謚貞肅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renchen day, the posthumous title Zhensu was granted to Li Dajie, former Remonstrance Officer of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen day, the posthumous title Zhensu was conferred on Li Dajie, former Remonstrance Officer under the Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命開平守臣釋奠於宣聖廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, the Shangdu garrison commander was ordered to perform the offering at the Temple of the Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Shangdu garrison commander was ordered to perform the offering at the Temple of the Sage.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以燕京等路宣撫使賽典赤為平章政事，敕以賀天爵為金齒等國安撫使，忽林伯副之，仍招諭使安其民。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Saidianchi, Pacification Commissioner of Yanjing and other circuits, was made Grand Councillor; He Tianjue was made Pacification Commissioner of the Gold Teeth and other states with Hulimbu as his deputy, and was also ordered to summon and instruct the people and settle them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Saidianchi, Pacification Commissioner of Yanjing and other circuits, was made Grand Councillor; He Tianjue was made Pacification Commissioner of the Gold Teeth and other states with Hulimbu as deputy, and ordered to summon the people and settle them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，諭武衛軍都指揮使李伯祐汰本軍疲老者，選精銳代之，給海青銀符一，有奏，馳驛以聞。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Li Boyou, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Army, was instructed to weed out the aged and weak of his army and replace them with picked men; he was given one silver tally of the sea-eagle type—with urgent business he might ride the relay post to report.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Li Boyou, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, was told to weed out the aged and weak and replace them with picked men; he received one sea-eagle silver tally and, on urgent business, might ride the relay post to report.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以宣撫使粘合南合為中書右丞，闊闊為中書左丞，賈文備為開元女直水達達等處宣撫使，賜虎符。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Pacification Commissioner Naiman Naiman was made Right Associate of the Central Secretariat, Kuoku Left Associate, and Jia Wenbei Pacification Commissioner of Kaiyuan, Jurchen, and Shuīdada and other regions, and granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Pacification Commissioner Naiman Naiman was made Right Associate of the Central Secretariat, Kuoku Left Associate, and Jia Wenbei Pacification Commissioner of Kaiyuan, Jurchen, Shuīdada, and other regions, and given a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 以宋降將王青為總管，教武衛軍習射。

translations.literal: Wang Qing, a Song defector general, was made Administrator and instructed to teach the Palace Guard Army archery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qing, a Song defector, was made Administrator and ordered to drill the Palace Guard in archery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禁以俘掠婦女為娼。

translations.literal: On yisi day, it was forbidden to make captive women into prostitutes.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court forbade making captive women into prostitutes.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Venus passed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus passed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 以許衡為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: Xu Heng was made Director of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Heng was made Director of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以姚樞為大司農，竇默仍翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Yao Shu was made Grand Minister of Agriculture, and Dou Mo remained Hanlin Attendant Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Yao Shu was made Grand Minister of Agriculture, and Dou Mo remained Hanlin Attendant Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 先是，以樞為太子太師，衡為太子太傅，默為太子太保，樞等以不敢當師傅禮，皆辭不拜，故復有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shu had been made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Heng Grand Mentor, and Mo Grand Guardian; Shu and the others, not daring to accept the rites due a tutor, all declined and did not bow—hence these appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Shu had been named Grand Preceptor to the Heir Apparent, Heng Grand Mentor, and Mo Grand Guardian; all three, not daring to accept a tutor's rites, had declined—hence these new appointments.

sentences.zh: 初立勸農司，以陳邃、崔斌、成仲寬、粘合從中為濱棣、平陽、濟南、河間勸農使，李士勉、陳天錫、陳膺武、忙古帶為邢洺、河南、東平、涿州勸農使。

translations.literal: The Agriculture Promotion Office was first established, with Chen Sui, Cui Bin, Cheng Zhongkuan, and Naiman Congzhong as Agriculture Promoters for Bin-Di, Pingyang, Jinan, and Hejian, and Li Shimian, Chen Tianxi, Chen Yingwu, and Mangudai for Xing-Ming, Henan, Dongping, and Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Agriculture Promotion Office was established, with Chen Sui, Cui Bin, Cheng Zhongkuan, and Naiman Congzhong as promoters for Bin-Di, Pingyang, Jinan, and Hejian, and Li Shimian, Chen Tianxi, Chen Yingwu, and Mangudai for Xing-Ming, Henan, Dongping, and Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命大名等路宣撫使歲給翰林侍講學士竇默、太醫副使王安仁衣糧，賜田以為永業。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, the Pacification Commissioner of Daming and other circuits was ordered to supply Hanlin Attendant Lecturer Dou Mo and Vice Director of the Imperial Medical Service Wang Anren with annual clothing and grain, and fields were granted them as permanent estates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Pacification Commissioner of Daming and other circuits was ordered to supply Hanlin Lecturer Dou Mo and Imperial Medical Vice Director Wang Anren with annual clothing and grain, and fields were granted them as permanent estates.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賞董文炳所將渡江及北征有功者二十二人，銀各五十兩。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, twenty-two men who had crossed the river and won merit in the northern campaign under Dong Wenbing were each rewarded with fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day twenty-two men who had crossed the river and won merit in Dong Wenbing's northern campaign each received fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 封順天等路萬戶張柔為安肅公，濟南路萬戶張榮為濟南公。

translations.literal: Zhang Rou, Myriarch of Shuntian and other circuits, was enfeoffed as Duke of Ansu; Zhang Rong, Myriarch of Jinan Circuit, as Duke of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rou, Myriarch of Shuntian and other circuits, was enfeoffed Duke of Ansu; Zhang Rong, Myriarch of Jinan Circuit, Duke of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 陜西四川行省乞就決邊方重刑，不允。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat requested authority to decide serious frontier cases on the spot; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat asked to decide serious frontier cases on the spot; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 詔陜西四川行省存恤歸附軍民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat to care for submitted soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to care for submitted soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 詔：「自今使臣有矯稱上命者，有司不得聽受。

translations.literal: An edict said: "From now on, if envoys falsely claim imperial orders, officials must not obey them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Henceforth, if envoys falsely claim imperial orders, officials must not obey.

sentences.zh: 諸王、后妃、公主、駙馬非聞奏，不許擅取官物。

translations.literal: Princes, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law may not take government goods without reporting to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, consorts, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law may not take government goods without reporting to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」賜慶壽寺、海雲寺陸地五百頃。

translations.literal: " Five hundred qing of land were granted to Qing Shou Temple and Haiyun Temple.
translations.idiomatic: " Five hundred qing of land were granted to Qing Shou Temple and Haiyun Temple.

sentences.zh: 敕西京運糧於沙井，北京運糧於魚兒泊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered grain transported from Xijing to Shajing and from Beijing to Yuripo.
translations.idiomatic: Xijing was ordered to transport grain to Shajing and Beijing to Yuripo.

sentences.zh: 立檀州驛。

translations.literal: The Tanzhou relay station was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Tanzhou relay station was established.

sentences.zh: 頒斗斛權衡。

translations.literal: Standard measures for dou, hu, and weights were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Standard measures for dou, hu, and weights were issued.

sentences.zh: 賑桓州饑民。

translations.literal: The hungry in Huanzhou were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: The hungry in Huanzhou received relief.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王塔察兒金千兩、銀五千兩、幣三百匹。

translations.literal: Prince Taqachar was granted one thousand taels of gold, five thousand taels of silver, and three hundred bolts of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Taqachar received one thousand taels of gold, five thousand taels of silver, and three hundred bolts of cloth.

sentences.zh: 給阿石寒甲價銀千二百兩。

translations.literal: One thousand two hundred taels of silver were given for Ashihan's armor.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand two hundred taels of silver were granted for Ashihan's armor.

sentences.zh: 核實新增戶口，措置諸路轉輸法。

translations.literal: Newly added households were verified, and transport methods for all circuits were arranged.
translations.idiomatic: Newly added households were verified and transport methods for all circuits were arranged.

sentences.zh: 命劉整招懷夔府、嘉定等處民戶。

translations.literal: Liu Zheng was ordered to summon and win over the households of Kuifu, Jiading, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng was ordered to summon and win over households in Kuifu, Jiading, and other places.

sentences.zh: 宋私商七十五人入宿州，議置於法，詔宥之，還其貨，聽榷場貿易。

translations.literal: Seventy-five Song private traders entered Suzhou; though the law called for punishment, an edict pardoned them, returned their goods, and allowed them to trade at the controlled markets.
translations.idiomatic: Seventy-five Song private traders entered Suzhou; though the law called for punishment, an edict pardoned them, returned their goods, and allowed trade at the controlled markets.

sentences.zh: 仍檄宋邊將還北人之留南者。

translations.literal: A dispatch was also sent to Song frontier generals to return northerners detained in the south.
translations.idiomatic: A dispatch was also sent to Song frontier generals demanding the return of northerners detained in the south.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，詔以忽突花宅為中書省署。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengshen new moon, an edict ordered that Hutuhua's residence serve as the Central Secretariat office.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month Hutuhua's residence was ordered to serve as the Central Secretariat office.

sentences.zh: 奉遷祖宗神主於聖安寺。

translations.literal: The spirit tablets of the ancestors were reverently moved to Sheng'an Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral spirit tablets were reverently moved to Sheng'an Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，邢州安撫使張耕告老，詔以其子鵬翼代之。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Zhang Geng, Pacification Commissioner of Xingzhou, reported old age; an edict ordered his son Pengyi to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Zhang Geng, Pacification Commissioner of Xingzhou, sought retirement; the court ordered his son Pengyi to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 武衛親軍都指揮使李伯祐、董文炳言：「武衛軍疲老者，乞補換，仍存恤其家。

translations.literal: Li Boyou and Dong Wenbing, Commanders-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Army, said: "The aged and weak of the Palace Guard Army beg to be replaced; their families should also be cared for.
translations.idiomatic: Li Boyou and Dong Wenbing, Commanders-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, reported: "The aged and weak of the guard beg to be replaced, and their families should be cared for.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔以粘合南合行中興府中書省。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict ordered Naiman Naiman to conduct Central Secretariat affairs at Zhongxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Naiman Naiman was ordered to conduct Central Secretariat affairs at Zhongxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大司農姚樞請以儒人楊庸教孔、顏、孟三氏子孫，東平府詳議官王鏞兼充禮樂提舉。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Yao Shu, Grand Minister of Agriculture, requested that the Confucian Yang Yong teach the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans, and that Wang Yong of Dongping, Detailed Review Officer, also serve as Commissioner for Rites and Music.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Grand Minister of Agriculture Yao Shu asked that the Confucian Yang Yong teach the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans, and that Wang Yong of Dongping, Detailed Review Officer, also serve as Commissioner for Rites and Music.

sentences.zh: 詔以庸為教授，以鏞特兼太常少卿。

translations.literal: An edict made Yang Yong Professor and specially appointed Wang Yong concurrently Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yong was made Professor, and Wang Yong was specially appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices as well.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以清、滄鹽課銀償往歲所貸民錢給公費者。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, silver from the Qing and Cang salt levies was used to repay money borrowed from the people the previous year for public expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day silver from the Qing and Cang salt levies repaid money borrowed from the people the previous year for public expenses.

sentences.zh: 置和糴所於開平，以戶部郎中宋紹祖為提舉和糴官。

translations.literal: A Grain Purchase Office was established at Shangdu, with Song Shaozu, Director in the Ministry of Revenue, as Commissioner of Grain Purchase.
translations.idiomatic: A Grain Purchase Office was established at Shangdu, with Song Shaozu of the Ministry of Revenue as Commissioner of Grain Purchase.

sentences.zh: 丙子，諭諸王、駙馬，凡民間詞訟無得私自斷決，皆聽朝廷處置。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, princes and imperial sons-in-law were instructed that no private judgment of civil lawsuits was permitted—all were to await disposition by the court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day princes and imperial sons-in-law were told they might not judge civil lawsuits privately—all were to await the court's disposition.

sentences.zh: 河南民王四妻靳氏一產三男，命有司量給贍養。

translations.literal: Jin Shi, wife of Wang Si of Henan, gave birth to three sons at one delivery; officials were ordered to grant support according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shi, wife of Wang Si of Henan, gave birth to three sons at one delivery; officials were ordered to grant support as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 敕今歲田租輸沿河近倉，官為轉漕，不可勞民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that this year's field rent be delivered to nearby granaries along the river, with the government handling transport— the people must not be overburdened.
translations.idiomatic: This year's field rent was to be delivered to nearby river granaries, with the government handling transport so the people would not be overburdened.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以甘肅等處新罹兵革，民務農安業者為戍兵所擾，遣阿沙、焦端義往撫治之。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, because the people of Gansu and other regions, newly afflicted by war, were being disturbed by garrison soldiers while trying to farm and settle, Asha and Jiao Duanyi were sent to pacify and govern them.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, because people in Gansu and other regions, newly scarred by war, were being harassed by garrison soldiers while trying to farm, Asha and Jiao Duanyi were sent to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 以海青銀符二、金符十給中書省，量軍國事情緩急，付乘驛者佩之。

translations.literal: Two sea-eagle silver tallies and ten gold tallies were given to the Central Secretariat to be issued according to the urgency of military and state affairs to those riding the relay post.
translations.idiomatic: Two sea-eagle silver tallies and ten gold tallies were given to the Central Secretariat to issue, according to the urgency of military and state affairs, to those riding the relay post.

sentences.zh: 以開元路隸北京宣撫司。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan Circuit was placed under the Beijing Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan Circuit was placed under the Beijing Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 真定路官民所貸官錢，貧不能償，詔免之。

translations.literal: Officials and people of Zhending Circuit who had borrowed government money and were too poor to repay were pardoned by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people of Zhending who had borrowed government money and were too poor to repay were pardoned by edict.

sentences.zh: 王鶚請於各路選委博學老儒一人，提舉本路學校，特詔立諸路提舉學校官，以王萬慶、敬鉉等三十人充之。

translations.literal: Wang E requested that one learned elder Confucian be selected in each circuit to supervise that circuit's schools; by special edict the office of Circuit Supervisor of Schools was established, with Wang Wanqing, Jing Xuan, and thirty others appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E asked that one learned elder Confucian be chosen in each circuit to supervise its schools; by special edict the office of Circuit Supervisor of Schools was established, with Wang Wanqing, Jing Xuan, and thirty others appointed.

sentences.zh: 敕燕京、順天等路續制人甲五千、馬甲及鐵裝具各二千。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yanjing, Shuntian, and other circuits to manufacture an additional five thousand sets of infantry armor and two thousand each of cavalry armor and iron fittings.
translations.idiomatic: Yanjing, Shuntian, and other circuits were ordered to manufacture an additional five thousand sets of infantry armor and two thousand each of cavalry armor and iron fittings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅朔，詔鳳翔府種田戶隸平陽兵籍，毋令出征，務耕屯以給軍餉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengyin new moon, an edict ordered that farming households of Fengxiang Prefecture be entered in the Pingyang military register, not sent on campaign, and devoted to garrison farming to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the tenth winter month, farming households of Fengxiang Prefecture were entered in the Pingyang military register, exempted from campaign, and set to garrison farming to supply the army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，陜西四川行省上言：「軍務急速，若待奏報，恐失事機。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat memorialized: "Military affairs are urgent; if we wait to report and receive reply, we may lose the moment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Shaanxi-Sichuan Branch Secretariat memorialized: "Military affairs are urgent; waiting for approval may cost us the moment.

sentences.zh: 」詔與都元帥紐璘會議行之。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered consultation with Grand Marshal Niuchin before acting.
translations.idiomatic: " The court ordered them to consult Grand Marshal Niuchin before acting.

sentences.zh: 遣道士訾洞春代祀東海廣德王廟。

translations.literal: The Daoist priest Zi Dongchun was sent to sacrifice at the Temple of the Broad Virtue King of the Eastern Sea in the Emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoist priest Zi Dongchun was sent to sacrifice at the Temple of the Broad Virtue King of the Eastern Sea in the Emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，敕火兒赤、奴懷率所部略地淮西。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered Qorichi and Nuqai to lead their commands in raiding Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Qorichi and Nuqai were ordered to lead their commands in raiding Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，敕愛亦伯等及陜西宣撫司校核不魯歡、阿藍塔兒所貸官銀。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, an edict ordered Ai Yibai and others and the Shaanxi Pacification Commission to audit government silver loaned by Buluqan and Alantar.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Ai Yibai and others, together with the Shaanxi Pacification Commission, were ordered to audit government silver loaned by Buluqan and Alantar.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以右丞張啟元行中書省於平陽、太原等路。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Right Associate Zhang Qiyuan was ordered to conduct Central Secretariat affairs in Pingyang, Taiyuan, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Right Associate Zhang Qiyuan was ordered to conduct Central Secretariat affairs in Pingyang, Taiyuan, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 括西京兩路官民，有壯馬皆從軍，令宣德州楊庭訓統之，有力者自備甲仗，無力者官與供給。

translations.literal: Officials and people of the two Xijing circuits who had strong horses were all to join the army; Yang Tingxun of Xuande Prefecture was ordered to command them—the able-bodied to supply their own armor and weapons, the unable to be supplied by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and people of the two Xijing circuits who owned strong horses were all to join the army under Yang Tingxun of Xuande—the able-bodied supplying their own arms, the rest receiving them from the government.

sentences.zh: 兩路奧魯官並在家軍人，凡有馬者並付新軍劉總管統領。

translations.literal: Ordu officials and soldiers at home in both circuits who had horses were all placed under the command of Administrator Liu of the new army.
translations.idiomatic: Ordu officials and soldiers at home in both circuits who owned horses were all placed under Administrator Liu of the new army.

sentences.zh: 昂吉所管西夏軍，並豐州、蕁麻林、夏水阿剌渾皆備鞍馬甲仗，及孛魯歡所管兵，凡徒行者市馬給之，並令從軍，違者以失誤軍期論。

translations.literal: The Western Xia army under Angji, together with Fengzhou, Semalin, and Xia Shui Alahun, were all to be equipped with saddles, horses, armor, and weapons; and among the troops under Boluqan, any who marched on foot were to be given horses purchased for them—all were ordered to join the campaign; violators were to be judged for missing the army deadline.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia army under Angji, with Fengzhou, Semalin, and Xia Shui Alahun, were all to be equipped with saddles, horses, armor, and weapons; among Boluqan's troops, any who marched on foot were to be given purchased horses—all were ordered to join the campaign, and violators were to be judged for missing the army deadline.

sentences.zh: 修燕京舊城。

translations.literal: Yanjing's old city was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on restoring Yanjing's old city.

sentences.zh: 命平章政事趙璧、左三部尚書怯烈門率蒙古、漢軍駐燕京近郊、太行一帶，東至平灤，西控關陜，應有險阻，於附近民內選諳武事者，修立堡寨守禦。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Zhao Bi and Minister of the Left Three Departments Qieliemen were ordered to lead Mongol and Han troops to garrison the suburbs of Yanjing and the Taihang range, east to Pingluan, west holding the approaches to Guan and Shaan; wherever there were defensible points, men skilled in military affairs were to be chosen from the nearby populace to build fortresses and garrisons for defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Grand Councilor Zhao Bi and Qieliemen, Minister of the Left Three Departments, to lead Mongol and Han forces into the suburbs of Yanjing and the Taihang range — east as far as Pingluan, west holding the passes into Guan and Shaan. At every strategic point they were to recruit militarily skilled men from the local population and erect fortresses to guard them.

sentences.zh: 以河南屯田萬戶史權為江漢大都督，依舊戍守。

translations.literal: Shi Quan, the ten-thousand-household commander of Henan agricultural colonies, was made Grand Commander of the Jiang-Han region and ordered to continue garrison duty as before.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Quan, the ten-thousand-household commander of Henan's agricultural colonies, was appointed Grand Commander of the Jiang-Han region and ordered to hold his posts as before.

sentences.zh: 又選銳卒三千付史樞管領，於燕京近郊屯駐。

translations.literal: Three thousand elite troops were additionally selected, placed under Shi's command, and garrisoned on the outskirts of Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand crack troops were additionally selected, placed under Shi's command, and encamped on the outskirts of Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命亳州張柔、歸德邸浹、睢州王文幹、水軍解成、張榮實、東平嚴忠嗣、濟南張宏七萬戶，以所部兵來會。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Zhang Rou of Bozhou, Di Xie of Guide, Wang Wengan of Suizhou, the naval commanders Jie Cheng and Zhang Rongshi, Yan Zhongsi of Dongping, and Zhang Hong of Jinan — seven wanhu — were ordered to bring their troops to rendezvous.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the seven wanhu commanders — Zhang Rou of Bozhou, Di Xie of Guide, Wang Wengan of Suizhou, the naval leaders Jie Cheng and Zhang Rongshi, Yan Zhongsi of Dongping, and Zhang Hong of Jinan — were summoned with their forces to assemble.

sentences.zh: 罷東平會計前任官侵用財賦。

translations.literal: The former officials of the Dongping accounting office who had embezzled fiscal revenues were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Former officers of the Dongping accounting bureau who had misappropriated revenues were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宋兵攻瀘州，劉整擊敗之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Song forces attacked Luzhou; Liu Zheng defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Song troops assaulted Luzhou, and Liu Zheng routed them.

sentences.zh: 詔賞整銀五千兩，幣帛二千匹。

translations.literal: An edict awarded Liu Zheng five thousand taels of silver and two thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zheng was rewarded by edict with five thousand taels of silver and two thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 失裏答、劉元振守禦有功，各賞銀五百兩，將士銀萬兩、幣帛千匹。

translations.literal: Shirimdai and Liu Yuanzhen, who had rendered distinguished service in defense, were each rewarded five hundred taels of silver; officers and soldiers received ten thousand taels of silver and one thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Shirimdai and Liu Yuanzhen, rewarded for their successful defense, each received five hundred taels of silver; the officers and soldiers under them were granted ten thousand taels of silver and one thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔指揮副使鄭江將千人赴開平，指揮使董文炳率善射者千人由魚兒泊赴行在所，指揮使李伯祐率余兵屯潮河川。

translations.literal: On yisi day, an edict ordered Vice Commander Zheng Jiang to lead a thousand men to Kaiping; Commander Dong Wenbing to lead a thousand skilled archers via Yur'er Lake to the Emperor's location; and Commander Li Boyou to encamp the remaining troops at the Chahe River.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day edicts directed Vice Commander Zheng Jiang to march a thousand men to Kaiping; Commander Dong Wenbing to bring a thousand crack archers by way of Yur'er Lake to the imperial camp; and Commander Li Boyou to hold the rest of the force at the Chahe River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔霍木海、乞帶等自得勝口至中都預備糧餉芻粟。

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered Hoqum, Qitai, and others to prepare grain, provisions, and fodder from Desheng Pass to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Hoqum, Qitai, and their officers were ordered to stock grain, provisions, and fodder along the route from Desheng Pass to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔平章政事塔察兒率軍士萬人，由古北口西便道赴行在所。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered Grand Councilor Tachar to lead ten thousand troops by the western shortcut through Gubeikou to the Emperor's location.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Grand Councilor Tachar was commanded to march ten thousand soldiers by the western route through Gubeikou to join the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，大兵與阿裏不哥遇於昔木土腦兒之地，諸王合丹等斬其將合丹火兒赤及其兵三千人，塔察兒與合必赤等復分兵奮擊，大破之，追北五十餘里。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renxu day, the main army encountered Ariq Böke at Shimultu Nar; Princes Kadan and others slew his general Qadan Qočin and three thousand of his troops; Tachar and Köke Böke and others again divided forces and struck fiercely, routing them utterly and pursuing north for more than fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the eleventh month the main army met Ariq Böke at Shimultu Nar. Prince Kadan and his brothers cut down the rebel general Qadan Qočin along with three thousand of his men; Tachar, Köke Böke, and the rest then divided their forces and pressed the attack, breaking the enemy completely and chasing them north for more than fifty li.

sentences.zh: 帝親率諸軍以躡其後，其部將阿脫等降，阿裏不哥北遁。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally led the armies in close pursuit; his officers Atai and others surrendered; Ariq Böke fled north.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor himself led the armies in pursuit. Ariq Böke's officers Atai and others came over, and Ariq Böke fled north.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the moon transited the Mao constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the moon entered the Pleiades.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔免今年賦稅。

translations.literal: On renshen day, an edict exempted this year's taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day an edict remitted the year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，駐蹕帖買和來之地。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the court halted at Temeghalai.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor encamped at Temeghalai.

sentences.zh: 以尚書怯烈門、平章趙璧兼大都督，率諸軍從塔察兒北上。

translations.literal: Minister Qieliemen and Grand Councilor Zhao Bi were made concurrent Grand Commanders and ordered to lead the armies north following Tachar.
translations.idiomatic: Qieliemen, Minister of State, and Grand Councilor Zhao Bi were appointed concurrent Grand Commanders and ordered to march the armies north in Tachar's wake.

sentences.zh: 分蒙古軍為二，怯烈門從麥肖出居庸口，駐宣德德興府；

translations.literal: The Mongol army was divided in two: Qieliemen, following Maixiao, went out through Juyong Pass and encamped at Xuande Dexing Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol forces were split in two. Qieliemen, marching with Maixiao, passed through Juyong Pass and halted at Xuande Dexing Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 訥懷從阿忽帶出古北口，駐興州。

translations.literal: Nequai, following Aqutai, went out through Gubeikou and encamped at Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Nequai, marching with Aqutai, passed through Gubeikou and halted at Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 帝親將諸萬戶漢軍及武衛軍，由檀、順州駐潮河川。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally commanded the wanhu Han armies and the Imperial Guard, passing through Tan and Shunzhou to encamp at the Chahe River.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor himself took command of the wanhu Han contingents and the Imperial Guard, moving through Tan and Shunzhou to encamp at the Chahe River.

sentences.zh: 敕官給芻糧，毋擾居民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that fodder and grain be supplied by the government and that residents not be molested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict provided that fodder and grain be issued by the state and that the local population not be disturbed.

sentences.zh: 罷十路宣撫司，止存開元路。

translations.literal: The ten-circuit Pacification Commissions were abolished; only Kaiyuan Circuit remained.
translations.idiomatic: The ten circuit pacification commissions were disbanded, leaving only Kaiyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 命諸路市馬二萬五千餘匹，授蒙古軍之無馬者。

translations.literal: An order was issued for the circuits to purchase more than twenty-five thousand horses and assign them to Mongol soldiers without mounts.
translations.idiomatic: The circuits were ordered to purchase more than twenty-five thousand horses and distribute them to Mongol troops who lacked mounts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，征諸路宣撫司官赴中都。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, pacification commissioners from all circuits were summoned to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the pacification commissioners of every circuit were summoned to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 移蹕於速木合打之地。

translations.literal: The court moved encampment to Sumughatai.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial camp was moved to Sumughatai.

sentences.zh: 詔漢軍屯懷來、縉山。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Han troops garrisoned at Huailai and Jinshan.
translations.idiomatic: Han troops were ordered to encamp at Huailai and Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 鷹坊阿裏沙及阿散兄弟二人以擅離扈從伏誅。

translations.literal: Alisha of the Eagle Office and the two brothers Asan were executed for leaving the imperial retinue without permission.
translations.idiomatic: Alisha of the Falconry Office and the two brothers Asan were put to death for abandoning the imperial retinue without leave.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，詔封皇子真金為燕王，領中書省事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengyin day, an edict enfeoffed the Prince Zhenjin as Prince of Yan and put him in charge of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the twelfth month an edict invested Crown Prince Zhenjin as Prince of Yan and placed him at the head of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Mars transited the Fang constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Mars entered the Fang asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，熒惑犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Mars transited the Gouqian constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Mars entered Gouqian.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以昌、撫、蓋利泊等處薦罹兵革，免今歲租賦。

translations.literal: On guisi day, because Chang, Fu, Gailibo, and other places had repeatedly suffered warfare, this year's land tax was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, as Chang, Fu, Gailibo, and neighboring districts had again been ravaged by war, the year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，師還，詔撤所在戍兵，放民間新簽軍。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the army returned; an edict ordered garrisons withdrawn and newly conscripted civilian soldiers released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the army returned. An edict recalled the garrisons and released the newly conscripted commoners from military service.

sentences.zh: 命太常少卿王鏞教習大樂。

translations.literal: Wang Yong, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was ordered to train performers in the great ritual music.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yong, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was charged with training the court musicians in the great ceremonial music.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以隆寒命諸王合必赤所部軍士無行帳者，聽舍民居。

translations.literal: On renyin day, because of severe cold, soldiers under Prince Köke Böke who lacked traveling yurts were permitted to lodge in private homes.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, owing to the bitter cold, soldiers under Prince Köke Böke who had no field tents were allowed to take shelter in private houses.

sentences.zh: 命陜蜀行中書省給綏德州等處屯田牛、種、農具。

translations.literal: The Shaan-Shu Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply Suide Prefecture and other places with oxen, seed, and farm implements for agricultural colonies.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaan-Shu Branch Secretariat was directed to provide Suide Prefecture and other districts with oxen, seed grain, and farm tools for the agricultural colonies.

sentences.zh: 初立宮殿府，秩正四品，專職營繕。

translations.literal: The Palace Construction Office was first established, rank 4a, exclusively responsible for building repairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Construction Office was established for the first time, at the fourth rank, with sole charge of building and maintenance.

sentences.zh: 立尚食局、尚藥局。

translations.literal: The Food Service Bureau and the Pharmaceutical Bureau were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Food Service Bureau and the Pharmaceutical Bureau were established.

sentences.zh: 初設控鶴五百四人，以劉德為軍使領之。

translations.literal: Four hundred four Crane Guard soldiers were first established, with Liu De as military commissioner to command them.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial Crane Guard of four hundred and four men was first organized, with Liu De appointed military commissioner to command them.

sentences.zh: 立異樣局達魯花赤，掌御用織造，秩正三品，給銀印。

translations.literal: A darughachi of the Special Weaves Bureau was established, in charge of imperial textile production, rank 3a, granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: A darughachi of the Special Weaves Bureau was appointed to oversee imperial textile manufacture, at the third rank, and given a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王金銀幣帛如歲例。

translations.literal: Princes were granted gold, silver, and silk according to the annual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The princes received their customary annual grants of gold, silver, and silks.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天下戶一百四十一萬八千四百九十有九，斷死罪四十六人。

translations.literal: This year, registered households under Heaven numbered 1,418,499; death sentences passed numbered 46.
translations.idiomatic: That year the empire registered 1,418,499 households and carried out forty-six death sentences.
